你于其中，又将是何物？
value:
If space were a sheet of paper, then lasers would be the brush that draws across it.
And within that canvas... what are you?

value: Oaken swings his one-handed sword in the air, performing up to two consecutive strikes.

value: Is the reflection in the mirror truly yourself? And what lies beyond the other side of the glass?

value: Arrived here under contract. The area is saturated with Hydrim energy, so proceed carefully. Of course, high risk means high reward. Resources are abundant here — take down any enemies in your path and secure what you can.

value: After generating a Shadow with this Trigger through a Perfect Dodge, the next dodge is guaranteed to trigger a Perfect Dodge.

key: 本触发器的影子爆炸可以被视为大招伤害，伤害提升60%
value: Explosions caused by this Trigger's Shadows are treated as Ultimate DMG and increase DMG by 60%.

value: Drones summoned by this Trigger have a 50% chance to perform an additional attack when dealing damage.

key: 本触发器召唤的无人机死亡时进入狂暴形态一定时间，大幅提升100%攻击力与100%攻击速度。狂暴时不计入召唤上限
value: When a drone summoned by this Trigger is destroyed, it enters Berserk Mode for a period of time, gaining 100% ATK and 100% Attack Speed. Berserk drones do not count toward the summon limit.

key: 因侵蚀污染而暴走的机械体，能以暴风骤雨般的火力摧毁敌人。瓦棱特精明能干，对工作保持高度专注的同时抱有上进野心。公司为表彰其卓越贡献，特意将他的意识数字化，让其继续为公司服务与勉励其他后世的员工。
value: A mechanized unit driven berserk by Devour contamination, capable of annihilating enemies with overwhelming firepower. Valente was sharp, efficient, and relentlessly ambitious, maintaining absolute focus on his work while constantly striving for bigger things. In recognition of his exceptional contributions, the company digitized his consciousness so he could continue serving the corporation and inspire future generations of employees.

key: 受到扰乱核心碎片寄生的蚀生体，亦是蹒跚于黑夜的往昔之人。
value: A Devourborne parasitized by shards of a Disturbance Core — once a person who staggered through the darkness of the night.

key:
生物聚落中霸主级的存在，受到侵蚀能感染后化为可怖的骇兽。身形伟岸且具备强大的破坏力，极具领土意识，性格暴戾，会对攻击一切入侵者。观测到曾有对同类施暴并使其顺服的习性，似乎保留了一定的社会性。
【备注：不喜欢鸟粪的味道，可以涂抹在身上规避被利刃恐浣的风险。】
value:
An apex predator within its ecosystem, transformed into a terrifying beast after being infected by Devour Energy. Massive in size and immensely destructive, it possesses an extreme territorial instinct and violently attacks all intruders. Observations suggest it retains traces of social behavior, including violently dominating others of its kind into submission.
[Note: It dislikes the smell of bird droppings. Smearing some on yourself may help avoid its horrifying attacks.]

key: 巨型鞘甲虫与射电脉冲器异合而成的蚀生体，蛰伏于深处禁止任何人接触尘封的禁忌。该蚀生体头部为军用射电脉冲器，用于为洲际战略武器精确制导，如今只为警戒周遭，侵攻一切胆敢窥探丑陋秘辛之人。
value: A Devourborne formed from the fusion of a giant sheathbeetle and a radio pulse transmitter. It lurks deep underground, forbidding anyone from approaching the forbidden secrets buried there. The creature's head is a military-grade radio pulse transmitter once used to guide intercontinental strategic weapons with pinpoint accuracy. Now, it serves only one purpose: to stand watch and annihilate anyone reckless enough to uncover the ugly truth.

key: 因侵蚀而产生逻辑链路紊乱的人形机器人。最初以保护人员为方针设计的机器人，如今它手上的利刃化为了那些当初被保护者最恐惧的阴影。
value: A humanoid robot whose logic circuits were disrupted by Devour. Originally designed with the protection of personnel in mind, the robot's blades have now become the very shadow feared by those it was meant to protect.

key: 因侵蚀而产生逻辑链路紊乱的镇爆型机器人。这种携带矢量步枪的机器人精确致命、虚无单发。人们都很喜欢这样充满效率的好家伙，直到这份效率被应用在他们身上。
value: A riot-control robot whose logic circuits were disrupted by Devour. Armed with a vector rifle, it delivers precise and lethal shots with ruthless efficiency. People always loved machines this efficient, right up until that efficiency was turned against them.

key: 受到侵蚀影响而逻辑链路出现故障的作业型机器人。手中的链锯原本是为人们切开障碍开辟生路的工具，谁能想到它还能切开人们的身体呢？
value: A labor robot whose logic circuits malfunctioned under the effects of Devour. The chainsaw it carries was originally meant to clear obstacles and carve out paths to safety. Who would've thought it could carve through people just as easily?

key: 受到侵蚀影响而逻辑链路出现故障的镇爆型机器人。以前他们是用来那些对付那些对公司制度不满的员工，现在倒好了，所有人都要挨它的铁棍子了。
value: A riot-control robot whose logic circuits malfunctioned under the effects of Devour. It used to be deployed against employees dissatisfied with company policy, and now everyone gets a turn under its steel baton.

key: 受到侵蚀影响而逻辑链路出现故障的镇爆型机器人。会分离出自己一部分动力源进行爆裂性攻击。
value: A riot-control robot whose logic circuits malfunctioned under the effects of Devour. It can detach part of its own power core and launch it as an explosive attack.

key: 受到侵蚀影响而逻辑链路出现故障的安保型机器人。专门用于护卫要员，掌握多种武术与格斗技巧的高端产品，是公司客户们的第一首选。现在公司的售后热线应该要被打爆了。
value: A security robot whose logic circuits malfunctioned under the effects of Devour. Designed specifically to protect high-value personnel, this premium model was equipped with advanced martial arts and close-combat techniques, making it the top choice among corporate clients. The company's customer support lines are probably overwhelmed by now.

key: 穿着重型装备的公司武装干员，由于神经高度与机械链路对接，所以在侵蚀的影响下变得神志不清，攻击任何胆敢靠近的敌人。公司为贵宾客户定制的高规格商品。你说这是人口贩卖？不，我们管这叫"终身雇佣"。
value: A heavily armored corporate operative. Due to the direct integration between its nervous system and mechanical linkages, Devour has driven it into a state of madness, causing it to attack anything that approaches. A premium product custom-made for elite corporate clients. Human trafficking, you say? No, we prefer to call it "lifetime employment."

key: 位于研究设施深处的战争机械，因侵蚀的影响而不受控制地自发启动，任何胆敢靠近者都会被它的炮火所歼灭。汇聚了公司心血与某种不切实际的野心铸造的怪物，希望其能成为公司开创某个时代的象征，被冠以"亚当"之名。但一切不过是幼稚且贪婪的幻想，就和这台"亚当"一样，缺乏"根基"。
value: A war machine buried deep within a research facility, now uncontrollably activated by Devour. Any who approach are obliterated by its overwhelming firepower. A monster forged from the company's obsession and an impossible ambition, intended to symbolize the dawn of a new era. They named it "Adam." But in the end, it was nothing more than a childish and greedy fantasy. Just like this machine itself, it lacked a true "foundation."

key:
由视讯器与蜘蛛组合而成的异合型蚀生体。较为罕见的蚀生体类型，通常出没于被侵蚀吞没的人类居住区中。传闻显像蛛骸会放映出受害者最为恐惧的视讯画面，让这些受害者一步步落入危险的圈套之中并猎杀他们……
【备注：传闻是假的，但可以用过近距离收发信号的方式影响其播放的内容，但一般来说都是呈雪花状的紊乱信号。】
value:
A hybrid Devourborne formed from a video display unit and a spider. A relatively rare type of Devourborne commonly found in human settlements consumed by Devour. Rumor has it these Screenspider Husks project terrifying visions tailored to their victims' deepest fears, luring them step by step into deadly traps before hunting them down...
[Note: The rumor is false, but its playback content can be influenced via close-range signal transmission. However, the result is usually a snow-like pattern of scrambled interference.]

key: 巨蟒与音波聚能器异合而成的蚀生体，两者在侵蚀能的影响下聚合在一起，同时还能看到一些人工缝合的痕迹。输出蛇骸能使用位于头部音频集群阵发射多类侵蚀辐射，需要谨慎回避，同时也能凭借夸张的弹跳力对敌人进行撞击。从飞溅到它身上的血迹判断，当年那些致力于实现偏执且疯狂的科学狂人付出了同等的代价，真是令人唏嘘……
value: A Devourborne fused from a giant python and a sonic energy amplifier. Under the influence of Devour Energy, the two merged together, with clear signs of crude surgical stitching still visible. The Serpent Husk can unleash multiple forms of Devour radiation through the acoustic arrays in its head, requiring extreme caution when engaging it. It can also slam into enemies with terrifying leaps. Judging from the bloodstains splattered across its body, the mad scientists who pursued their twisted obsession likely paid the same brutal price themselves. A grim thought...

key: 大型兽类与信息调频器异合而成的蚀生体，两者在侵蚀能的影响下聚合在一起，同时还能看到一些人工缝合的痕迹。调频兽骸通常来说不会主动的攻击敌人，但他可以通过发射某种信号来召唤各类异合蚀骸协战。这到底是侵蚀的毁灭意志所引导的变异，亦或者是其最初诞生的目的，具体缘由以被冰雪所掩埋，无人可知。
value: A Devourborne fused from a large beast and an information frequency modulator. Under the influence of Devour Energy, the two merged together, with clear signs of crude surgical stitching still visible. Frequency Beasthusks rarely take the initiative to attack, but they can broadcast signals that summon various Devoured Remains to fight alongside them. Whether this mutation was guided by the destructive will of Devour, or was the creature's original intended purpose, has long since been buried beneath ice and snow.

key: 在发电厂进行采集时有30%概率获得双倍奖励
value: There is a 30% chance to obtain double rewards while gathering in the Power Plant.

value: Unleashes up to 4 rapid attacks against enemies ahead. Fire rate increases continuously during the attack.

value: Attacks while airborne, then dives diagonally downward to strike enemies along the path and deal AoE DMG upon landing.

key: 对斜下方的敌人进行最多重复四次的连续快速攻击。射击过程中，射速会越来越快。
value: Unleashes up to 4 rapid attacks against enemies below at a diagonal angle. Fire rate increases continuously during the attack.

key: 触发完美闪避后立刻进行攻击，则会发动普攻的第四段。
value: Attacks immediately after triggering a Perfect Dodge to activate the fourth instance of the basic attack combo.

key: 短暂蓄力后向前射出特殊子弹，造成伤害并生成立场，为全队角色恢复少量生命值，且在一定时间内抵挡弹道类攻击。

key: 对前方的敌人进行高速攻击，最后短暂蓄力发动终结攻击。
value: Launches a high-speed assault against enemies ahead, then briefly charge before delivering a finishing strike.

key: 突入战场后短暂蓄力，向前旋转突击，攻击下方的敌人。

key: 释放自身的潜力引唤风雷，对身周一定范围内进行雷电轰击。
value: Unleashes the full potential and calls forth storm and thunder, bombarding nearby enemies with lightning strikes.

key: 以收讯器与大型兽类组合而成的异合型蚀生体。它的巨大身躯以常人理解的灵敏对敌人发动势大力沉的攻击。一般来说，就算有侵蚀能的加持，生物体与机械体也很难进行如此恰当的耦合，而我只能从那些深入骨髓的机械芯片与肢体边缘的缝合线上，窥视过往真相的一鳞半爪……
value: A hybrid Devourborne created from a receiver fused with a massive beast. Despite its enormous body, it attacks with shocking speed and crushing force far beyond normal understanding. Even enhanced by Devour Energy, biological and mechanical lifeforms should not be able to integrate this perfectly. Yet from the mechanical chips embedded deep in the bone and the sutured seams along the edges of the body, one can glimpse fragments of a terrible truth from the past...

key:
“回溯”中的一幕幕令你备感疑惑，想要将它们全部厘清的话需要一定的时间。
在林缉风理事长的建议下，你在心中将目前的事情排列了优先级，决定暂时向小队成员隐瞒刚才所看到的事情，以委托为重。
value:
The scenes revealed through the "Retrospective" leave you deeply unsettled. Untangling everything you witnessed will take time.
At Chairperson Lin Jifeng's suggestion, you reorganize your priorities and decide, for now, to keep what you saw hidden from the rest of the team and focus on the commission first.

key: 以聚能器与大型鸟类组合而成的异合型蚀生体。他们会使用强有力的下肢对敌人发动踢击或根据聚能器的种类发射不同的能量束。就算在侵蚀能的浸染下，大型生物体与机械体也很难进行如此恰当的耦合，而我只能从那些深入骨髓的机械芯片与肢体边缘的缝合线上，窥视过往真相的一鳞半爪……
value: An hybrid Devourborne created from an energy amplifier fused with a giant bird. They attack enemies with powerful kicks from their reinforced legs or fire different energy beams depending on the type of amplifier attached. Even under the influence of Devour Energy, large biological and mechanical lifeforms should not be able to integrate this perfectly. Yet from the mechanical chips embedded deep in the bone and the sutured seams along the edges of the body, one can glimpse fragments of a terrible truth from the past...

key: 在地面特殊攻击的最后，对前方敌人释放强力攻击。
value: At the end of the Ground Special Attack combo, unleashes a powerful strike against enemies ahead.

key: 地面特殊终结和异能爆发命中敌人时，会对其施加<color=#0b77c7>【破甲】</color>，持续15秒。
value: When Ground Special Finishers and Special Ability Bursts hit enemies, inflict <color=#0b77c7>Armor Break</color> for 15s.

key: 不知名的世界被原态侵蚀毁灭后，曾经生活于其中的生物遗留在侵蚀中的倒影。它们没有思想和智慧，只剩世界毁灭时的意志化作的强大攻击性，驱使它们永无止境地相互残杀。
value: After an unknown world was destroyed by Primordial Devour, what remained were echoes of the beings that once lived there, left behind within the Devour itself. They possess no thought or intelligence, only a fierce, unending aggression formed from the will of that world's final collapse, driving them to slaughter one another without end.

key: 在原态侵蚀的黄昏中独自游荡的孤独骑士。虽然只是不知何年代流落到侵蚀中的一道遗影，但从无数彷徨遗影中拼杀而出的他，拥有令人仰望的实力和战斗意志，甚至时刻保持着最适合战斗的姿态。即使是那些强大的使徒也不愿轻撄其锋。如此超群之人，在其生活的年代绝不会是籍籍无名之辈。
value: A lone knight wandering through the twilight of Primordial Devour. Though merely a lingering shadow cast into the Devour from some forgotten era, he carved his way through countless lost echoes and emerged with overwhelming strength and unshakable battle instinct. Even now, he maintains a stance perfectly suited for combat at all times. Even the mighty apostles avoid crossing blades with him lightly. A warrior of such caliber could never have been a nobody in his own age.

key: 巨大的扇轮处理着工厂能源，即便工厂已经废弃也仍在运转。
value: A massive fan wheel still churns the factory's energy systems, continuing to run even though the facility has long been abandoned.

key: 空旷且宁静，这里弥漫着令人着迷的虚幻与死亡。
value: Silent and hollow, this place is steeped in a strange blend of allure, illusion, and death.

key: 地面普通攻击最后一段突击结束后，可以看准时机发动一次回身反突。
value: After the final thrust of the Ground Basic Attack combo, times the input to perform a turning counter-thrust.

key: 每次瞬移到<color=#0b77c7>【赤翎】</color>处时，恢复<color=#0b77c7>【临界值】</color>。<color=#0b77c7>【临界值】</color>满时，可以消耗所有<color=#0b77c7>【临界值】</color>，进入<color=#0b77c7>【昭形】</color>状态。
value: Each time you teleport to <color=#0b77c7>Emberplume</color>, restore <color=#0b77c7>Threshold Value</color>. When <color=#0b77c7>Threshold Value</color> is full, consume all <color=#0b77c7>Threshold Value</color> to enter <color=#0b77c7>Manifestation</color> state.

key: 掷出<color=#0b77c7>【赤翎】</color>后，莲立刻突入战场，并对周围造成伤害。
value: After throwing <color=#0b77c7>Emberplume</color>, LIAN immediately dives into battle, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

key:
人会向往梦境。为了获得无边的美好，为了不再感受悲伤。但同样，人会直面现实，迈向未来。这是我们应有的坚毅与勇气。
为已然消逝的过去画下句点吧。
value:
Humans are drawn to dreams, longing for boundless beauty, for an end to sorrow. Yet they also face reality and move toward the future. That is the resolve and courage we are meant to have.
Bring closure to a past that has already faded away.

key: 发电厂遭到侵蚀影响，里面的军用机器人发生动乱，需要您立马前往目标地点消除威胁。
value: The power plant has been affected by Devour, and the military robots inside have gone rogue. You are to proceed to the target location immediately and eliminate the threat.

key: 调度整个工厂信息的区域，存放了大量保密信息。
value: A control sector that manages the entire factory's data systems, storing a large volume of classified information.

key: 连接着电梯通道的工厂大厅。正是当年那些勇敢无谓的人们建起工厂，建起奥鲁姆城。
value: The main factory hall connected to the elevator shafts. It was once built by fearless people who laid the foundations of both the facility and Orum City itself.

key: 负责检修的工作厂房，精妙的流水线代表着这里曾经的辉煌。
value: A maintenance workshop where precision assembly lines reflect the facility's former glory.

key: 从机密工业品的测试数据到某个工人的牢骚，无数繁杂的信息在这里流转、存储。
value: From classified industrial test data to the idle complaints of workers, countless streams of information once flowed and were stored here.

key: 仅仅只是一介凡人的妄想野心，却要以无数无辜者为代价。
value: It was nothing more than the delusion of an ambitious individual, yet paid for with the lives of countless innocents.

key: 由于变异生物的活跃，奥鲁姆城的郊外和地下遍布着这样的检修节点，如果出现损坏就意味着危机即将降临。
value: Due to the activity of mutated organisms, maintenance nodes like these are scattered across the outskirts and underground areas of Orum City. Any damage to them signals an impending crisis.

key: 任何一头接近这里的变异生物都将触发警报。与检修节点不同，这些节点更类似于警报装置，分布于奥鲁姆城近郊和生活区附近，能第一时间对各种信息发出预警信号。
value: Any mutated creature approaching will trigger an alert. Unlike maintenance nodes, these function more like alarm beacons, distributed around suburban and residential zones of Orum City to provide early warning against various threats.

key: 为了奥鲁姆城未来的发展而在地下建设的隧洞，虽然已经停工许久，但象征着奥鲁姆城最辉煌时期人类的野心与对未来的憧憬。
value: These underground tunnels were built for Orum City's future development. Though construction stopped long ago, they still embody the peak of the city's era of ambition and its vision of the future.

key: 曾经处理奥鲁姆城污水的地方，充斥着各种各样奇怪的怪物。伴随着时代发展，这里被抛弃了，和地下城建一起。
value: Once used for wastewater processing in Orum City, this area is now filled with all kinds of strange creatures. With the march of time, it was abandoned along with the underground infrastructure.

key: 已经崩毁的通道，但伴随着那场灾难，和地下城建一起被埋没在了地底深处。
value: A collapsed passage, buried deep underground alongside the rest of the subterranean infrastructure in the wake of that catastrophe.

key: 你们回收了最后一处数据，但一路上见到的种种异状让你们打算继续前进。
value: You recovered the final data cache, but the anomalies you'd encountered along the way made you decide to press onward.

key: 莲催动异能召唤出数道剑刃，对范围内的敌人造成毁灭性打击并进入<color=#0b77c7>【昭形】</color>状态。
value: LIAN channels her Special Abilities to summon countless blades, devastating all enemies within range and entering <color=#0b77c7>Manifestation</color> state.

key:
排查并清剿该区域危及社会安全的蚀生体。
玩家可以自行选择委托回报倍率，委托中怪物的数量和强度会随着回报倍率的增加而上升，且领取奖励所消耗的体力越多，奖励也更丰富。
value:
Eliminate the Devourborne in this area that pose a threat to public safety.
Players may freely select a commission reward multiplier. As the multiplier increases, the number and strength of enemies will scale accordingly. Higher stamina costs will also yield greater rewards.

key: 下水道里有你想要的一切,前提是你要有与之对等的勇气。
value: There's everything you could ever want in the sewers, if you've got the courage to match it.

key: 累计获得100,000,000卢克的奖励

value: As expected, you located the Spatiotemporal Singularity at the recalculated coordinates. But a new complication emerged — it had fused with a Devourborne. This was an impossible condition in the natural world. A sense of unease lingered, but the truth could only be uncovered by pursuing that "Anomalous Devourborne."

key: 在与莉塔成功会合后，你终于知晓了她所说的难题——原先的任务目标“时空奇点”并没有出现在你们精心计算得出的坐标位置。你无法确定这一异常是否与时序重构仪的故障有关，决定在时序重构仪过热之前做最后一次尝试。重新计算过后，你得出了一个新的坐标……
value: After reuniting with Rita, you finally learned the issue she'd encountered: the original target, the Spatiotemporal Singularity, did not appear at the computed coordinates. It was unclear whether this anomaly was caused by a malfunction in the Temporal Reconstructor. With the system nearing overheating, you decided to make one final attempt. A recalculation yielded a new set of coordinates...

key: 契尔斯通采矿作业标准装备。为防止蚀生体袭击造成的冲撞，特采用了最坚固的合金材质，负重有所增加。
value: Standard mining gear issued by Keystone. Built with reinforced alloy plating to withstand impacts caused by Devourborne attacks, at the cost of increased weight.

key: 契尔斯通采矿作业标准装备。类蝇嗅觉装置制成的高灵敏度气体分析仪，显著增强感官敏感度和抗干扰能力。
value: Standard mining gear issued by Keystone. A highly sensitive gas analyzer built using fly-inspired olfactory technology, greatly enhancing sensory perception and resistance to interference.

key: 契尔斯通采矿作业标准装备。源于对生物视觉的模仿，最先进的视觉辅助系统，ATR技术的集大成者。
value: Standard mining gear issued by Keystone. Inspired by biological vision, this cutting-edge visual support system represents the pinnacle of ATR technology.

key: 契尔斯通采矿作业标准装备。精确监测神经活动、刺激目标脑区并输送局部药物，用于协助稳定神经和情绪，使用者需签署知悉协议。
value: Standard mining gear issued by Keystone. Precisely monitors neural activity, stimulates targeted regions of the brain, and administers localized medication to help stabilize nerves and emotions. Users are required to sign an informed consent agreement before use.

key: 契尔斯通勘探作业标准装备。为满足长期野外作业需求，内容量是普通核心的三倍，并对内容物真空压缩存储。
value: Standard exploration gear issued by Keystone. Designed for extended field operations, its internal capacity is triple that of a Standard Core, with all contents vacuum-compressed for storage.

key: 契尔斯通勘探作业标准装备。结合了过滤装置和扫描面甲的多种功能，综合性能显著提升，但体积较大。
value: Standard exploration gear issued by Keystone. Integrates the functions of a filtration system and scanning faceplate into a single unit, offering greatly improved overall performance at the cost of increased bulk.

key: 契尔斯通勘探作业标准装备。根据目标位置和周边环境实时调整行进路线，内置引擎，可作为辅助动力源。
value: Standard exploration gear issued by Keystone. Dynamically adjusts travel routes in real time based on terrain and target positioning. Equipped with an internal engine that can also function as an auxiliary power source.

key: 契尔斯通勘探作业标准装备。以涌晶裂解为动力核心的推进装置，能够协助短时浮空，增强佩戴者作战机动性。
value: Standard exploration gear issued by Keystone. A propulsion device powered by Surgarite decomposition, capable of enabling short-term levitation and enhancing the wearer's combat mobility.

key: 黑市流通的装备。以防出现意外，有人在上面贴心的刻下了一行小字：使用时请注意控制方向并判断距离。
value: Equipment circulated on the black market. In case of accidents, someone thoughtfully engraved a small warning on it: "Please mind your direction and distance while operating."

key: 黑市流通的装备。抹去痕迹，隐匿于无形，像一道能够消除一切的雨幕，穿戴时可以在侵蚀区的雨中起舞。
value: Equipment circulated on the black market. Erases all traces and hides its wearer in plain sight, like a curtain of rain that washes everything away. When equipped, one can practically dance through the rain inside Devouring Areas.

key: 黑市流通的装备。映照出的无数个敌人里，光会告诉你何处才是真正的突破口，另——不建议用来当镜子。
value: Equipment circulated on the black market. Among the countless reflections of your enemies, the light will reveal the true point of breakthrough. One more thing — using it as a mirror is not recommended.

key: 黑市流通的装备。备选方案是智慧的象征，它会在关键时刻助你一臂之力，当然，在此之外最好有个正式方案。
value: Equipment circulated on the black market. A backup plan is the mark of true intelligence. It may just save your life at a critical moment, though ideally, you should still have an actual plan prepared.

key: 黑厅部员配备的标准装备。便携式营养物质储存器，能支持个体一段时间的生命活动。
value: Standard equipment issued to Black Hall personnel. A portable nutrient storage unit capable of sustaining basic biological functions for a limited period of time.

key: 黑厅部员配备的标准装备。防护功能能够满足日常所需，抗侵蚀功能仍有待提升。
value: Standard equipment issued to Black Hall personnel. Provides sufficient protection for daily operations, though its anti-Devour capabilities still require improvement.

key: 黑厅部员配备的标准装备。除定位功能外还配备了短距无线通信功能，可在特定频率内发送和接收信息。
value: Standard equipment issued to Black Hall personnel. In addition to positioning functions, it is equipped with short-range wireless communication capabilities for transmitting and receiving information on designated frequencies.

key: 黑厅部员配备的标准装备。激活后可为使用者提供多项能力增幅，持续时间仍有待提升。
value: Standard equipment issued to Black Hall personnel. Once activated, it grants the user multiple performance enhancements, though its operational duration still leaves room for improvement.

key: 亚纳秒级闪存器件，史上最快的半导体电荷存储技术。又快又准的除了传奇猎人的枪法，还有它。
value: A sub-nanosecond flash memory device, the fastest semiconductor charge storage technology ever created. Faster and more accurate than anything except a legendary hunter's aim.

key: 拥有完美架构的超强GPU，搭载了最为先进的演算智能。真理的钥匙已经握在手中，你需要做的只有推开门。
value: A top-tier GPU built on a flawless architecture and powered by the most advanced computational intelligence available. The key to truth is already in your hands — all that remains is to open the door.

key: 极其先进的光学扫描系统，是功能相当强悍的输入设备。能够看透一切武装、构造、骨骼……以及人心。
value: An extremely advanced optical scanning system and a remarkably powerful input device. Capable of seeing through weapons, structures, skeletons... and even the human heart.

key: 具有长寿命、高能量密度和高功率密度的动力电池。充满仅需十分钟，能够为高功率武器提供长效支持。
value: A high-performance power cell with exceptional lifespan, energy density, and output capacity. Fully charges in just ten minutes and provides long-lasting support for high-powered weaponry.

key: 黑市流通的装备。源自某种先进设备的拆解件，能够你的承载一切所需。
value: Equipment circulated on the black market. Salvaged components from an unidentified advanced device, capable of carrying everything you need.

key: 黑市流通的装备。实现信号的快速捕获和稳定跟踪，在空间复杂的电磁环境中也能运行。
value: Equipment circulated on the black market. Enables rapid signal acquisition and stable tracking, maintaining functionality even in highly complex electromagnetic environments.

key: 黑市流通的装备。现已载荷空间测距模块，能够实现最精准的位置解算。
value: Equipment circulated on the black market. Now equipped with a spatial ranging module capable of delivering extremely precise positional calculations.

key: 黑市流通的装备。对当务之急的完美解释，比人脑更迅速更理性。
value: Equipment circulated on the black market. The perfect answer to urgent situations, faster and more rational than the human brain.

key: 以涌晶聚合技术为原理所制造的驱动装置，原材料是价值不菲的高纯度涌晶， 能够为使用者持续供能。
value: A drive unit built using Surgarite aggregation technology. Crafted from extremely valuable high-purity Surgarites, it provides sustained energy output to the user.

key: 为应对各种局面所特制的面甲，内部结构十分复杂机巧，最外层由数以亿万计的纳米机器人联结覆盖。
value: A visor specially designed to handle a wide range of scenarios. Its internal structure is extraordinarily intricate, while the outermost layer is formed from billions of interconnected nanobots.

key: 获取信息的方式迅速而精准，不易受到环境因素干扰，能够持续监测周边环境的动态变化。
value: Acquires information rapidly and accurately while remaining highly resistant to environmental interference, allowing for continuous monitoring of surrounding conditions in real time.

key: 使用了最新的知觉强化技术，显著提升使用者的精神力和专注力。
value: Built using the latest perception enhancement technology, significantly improving the user's mental acuity and concentration.

key: 由泽尔联合制造的生命支持装置。内部储存大量营养物质，能够为使用者提供基础的生命供给。
value: A life-support device manufactured by Zelle Complex. Stores a large reserve of nutrients capable of sustaining the user's basic biological needs.

key: 由泽尔联合制造的钛合金覆面。重量较为轻便，具备初级抗侵蚀功能。
value: A titanium-alloy visor manufactured by Zelle Complex. Lightweight in design and equipped with basic anti-Devour functionality.

key: 由泽尔联合制造的精密仪表。能够监测周边蚀生体活跃程度，具备初级抗侵蚀功能。
value: A precision instrument manufactured by Zelle Complex. Capable of monitoring nearby Devourborne activity while providing basic anti-Devour functionality.

key: 由泽尔联合制造的防护强化组件。激活后能够在短时间内提升使用者的战斗能力，可通过充能实现循环使用。
value: A defensive enhancement module manufactured by Zelle Complex. Once activated, it temporarily boosts the user's combat performance and can be reused through recharging.

key: 泽尔联合于2050年出产的营养瓶。设计原理十分简单，营养物质的种类与含量较为匮乏。
value: A nutritional bottle produced by Zelle Complex in 2050. Its design is extremely straightforward, though both the variety and quantity of nutrients are fairly limited.

key: 泽尔联合于2050年出产的复合材料面罩。为满足批量生产的需求，整体设计精度较低，有一定重量感。
value: A composite-material mask produced by Zelle Complex in 2050. Designed for mass production, resulting in lower overall precision and a noticeably heavier feel.

key: 泽尔联合于2050年出产的定位罗盘。在侵蚀区气候稳定且无其他因素干扰时，能够协助使用者判断方位。
value: A navigation compass produced by Zelle Complex in 2050. Able to assist the user in determining direction when environmental conditions inside Devouring Areas remain stable and interference is minimal.

key: 泽尔联合于2050年出产的强化组件。激活方式较为单一，能为使用者提供一定的战斗增幅。
value: An enhancement module produced by Zelle Complex in 2050. Its activation method is relatively simple, but it still provides the user with a moderate combat boost.

key: 用于记录干掉了多少，至于干掉的是什么，不重要。
value: Used to keep count of how many targets have been taken down. As for what those targets were... that part doesn't matter.

key: 奥鲁姆岸防军战术组标准装备。新型全能核心装置，生命科技的最新研究成果，外壳较为脆弱。
value: Standard gear issued to the Orum Coastguard Tactical Team. A next-generation multifunctional core unit representing the latest breakthroughs in biotech research, though its outer shell is relatively fragile.

key: 奥鲁姆岸防军战术组标准装备。用于精准战斗的抗后坐力武器瞄准镜，在多种因素干扰下也能保证视觉功能。
value: Standard gear issued to the Orum Coastguard Tactical Team. A recoil-resistant combat optic built for precision engagements, capable of maintaining visual stability even under multiple forms of interference.

key: 奥鲁姆岸防军战术组标准装备。能将必要的环境数据直接投射至使用者的视觉系统，耗能较高。
value: Standard gear issued to the Orum Coastguard Tactical Team. Projects critical environmental data directly into the user's visual system, though its energy consumption is relatively high.

key: 奥鲁姆岸防军战术组标准装备。向预定目标发射浓缩的等离子体束，随后将其点燃，在空气和液体中均能起效。
value: Standard gear issued to the Orum Coastguard Tactical Team. Fires a concentrated plasma beam at the designated target before igniting it, effective in both air and liquid environments.

key: 只要她在场，周围的温度就会降低，即使并非她的本意。
value: As long as she's nearby, the temperature around her drops, even when she doesn't mean for it to.

key: 剑柄上有一层薄薄的白霜，于是她只能握得更紧一些。
value: A thin layer of frost coats the hilt, forcing her to grip it just a little tighter.

key: 自动判断周围的敌人是否可被攻击，优秀的设计。
value: Automatically determines whether nearby enemies are valid targets. An excellent piece of design.

key: 把附近敌人的生命力数值化并用清晰的界面标注，毫不冗余。
value: Quantifies the vitality of nearby enemies and displays it through a clean, efficient interface with zero unnecessary clutter.

key: 将如何战胜敌人的思维实验进行实际操演，符合需求。
value: Transforms theoretical combat simulations into practical execution, exactly as intended.

key: 存有大量胜利经验，让眼前的敌人也成为它的一部分，非常合理。
value: Stores an enormous amount of combat data from past victories, ensuring the enemy before it becomes part of that record as well. Perfectly reasonable.

key: 泽尔联合赫菲斯托斯实验室第六代装备套组。华丽的外观和强悍的性能可以共存的证明。
value: A sixth-generation equipment set developed by the Hephaestus Laboratory of Zelle Complex. Proof that dazzling aesthetics and overwhelming performance can coexist.

key: 泽尔联合赫菲斯托斯实验室第六代装备套组。使用了某种保密材料，防御和反击性能极为卓越。
value: A sixth-generation equipment set developed by the Hephaestus Laboratory of Zelle Complex. Built using classified materials, offering exceptional defensive and counterattack capabilities.

key: 泽尔联合赫菲斯托斯实验室第六代装备套组。追踪探测的技术远超同行业，造价也极其高昂。
value: A sixth-generation equipment set developed by the Hephaestus Laboratory of Zelle Complex. Its tracking and detection technology far surpasses industry standards, and its production cost reflects that.

key: 泽尔联合赫菲斯托斯实验室第六代装备套组。危险的奇迹， 能够制造有利转机。
value: A sixth-generation equipment set developed by the Hephaestus Laboratory of Zelle Complex. A dangerous miracle capable of creating favorable turning points.

key: 奥鲁姆岸防军援护组标准装备。装备套组的核心部件，启动后能够为其他组件供能。
value: Standard gear issued to the Orum Coastguard Support Team. The core component of the equipment set, capable of supplying power to all other modules once activated.

key: 奥鲁姆岸防军援护组标准装备。坚如金石，能够为佩戴者抵御致命伤害。
value: Standard gear issued to the Orum Coastguard Support Team. Solid as bedrock, capable of shielding the wearer from fatal damage.

key: 奥鲁姆岸防军援护组标准装备。向己方播报自己的坐标，协助判断危险来临的方向。
value: Standard gear issued to the Orum Coastguard Support Team. Broadcasts the user's coordinates to allies, helping identify the direction of incoming danger.

key: 奥鲁姆岸防军援护组标准装备。每条守则都由经验和鲜血换取而来，弥足珍贵。
value: Standard gear issued to the Orum Coastguard Support Team. Every protocol was written in experience and blood, making each one invaluable.

key: 泽尔联合以黑质净化为目的研发的实验性维生装置。额外加装了造氧功能，以适应多种环境。
value: An experimental life-support device developed by Zelle Complex for Tenebrium purification. Equipped with an additional oxygen-generation system to adapt to a wide range of environments.

key: 泽尔联合以黑质净化为目的研发的实验性过滤装置。对有害粒子进行隔绝，净化率高达99%。
value: An experimental filtration device developed by Zelle Complex for Tenebrium purification. Blocks harmful particles with a purification rate of up to 99%.

key: 泽尔联合以黑质净化为目的研发的实验性探测装置。实时监测周边环境变化，调谐内外温湿度。
value: An experimental detection device developed by Zelle Complex for Tenebrium purification. Monitors environmental changes in real time while regulating internal and external temperature and humidity levels.

key: 泽尔联合以黑质净化为目的研发的实验性增压装置。定时跟随侵蚀区内压力增减，完善自体内外压平衡。
value: An experimental pressure-boosting device developed by Zelle Complex for Tenebrium purification. Automatically adjusts to pressure fluctuations within Devouring Areas to maintain internal and external pressure balance.

key: 作为特别机动队的队长，你正在为侵蚀管理局执行一项目标为“捕获时空奇点”的任务。由于时序重构仪发生故障，你与队员洛夕在进入时空残片未能抵达预定的坐标位置，并且与另一名队员“莉塔”失散。你的首要目标是冷静下来，并寻找失散的队员。
value: As the captain of the Special Mobile Unit, you had been carrying out a mission for the E.Z.C to capture the Spatiotemporal Singularity. After a malfunction in the Temporal Reconstructor, you and your teammate ROCHE failed to arrive at the designated coordinates upon entering the Spatiotemporal Fragment and became separated from another squad member, Rita. Your top priority was to stay calm and locate your missing teammate.

key: 在寻找线索和失散的队员时，你跟洛夕意外发现了此前侵蚀管理局送入时空残片的探测机器人“罗伯特”。探测机器人除了表面的锈迹之外，核心部件似乎还维持完好状态。你不禁好奇，探测机器人究竟会记录下什么样的图像与信息呢？
value: While searching for clues and your missing squadmate, you and ROCHE unexpectedly discovered "Robert," a recon robot previously deployed into the Spatiotemporal Fragment by the E.Z.C. Aside from visible rust on its exterior, its core systems appeared to remain intact. You couldn't help but wonder what kind of images and data it might have recorded.

key: 通过读取磁盘，你和洛夕发现了一段探索机器人“罗伯特”记录下的音频。
value: By reading the disk, you and ROCHE discovered an audio log recorded by the recon robot "Robert."

key: 你与洛夕再次发现了探索机器人“罗伯特”，并带走了它的磁盘。
value: You and ROCHE came across the recon robot "Robert" once again and retrieved its disk.

key: 通过读取磁盘，你和洛夕发现了一段探索机器人“罗伯特”记录下的影像，发现时空残片以前有可能是像哈洛一样的宜居行星。
value: By accessing the disk, you and ROCHE discovered footage recorded by the recon robot "Robert," revealing that the Spatiotemporal Fragment may once have been a habitable planet much like Halo.

key: 塔可托我们帮忙寻找一个圆球，背后的理由令人暖心——奥鲁姆城一位富人家的狗认不得主，只认这个亮闪闪的玩具球。
value: TACO asked for our help tracking down a missing orb. The reason behind it turned out to be oddly heartwarming: a wealthy family's dog in Orum City only recognized this shiny toy ball and refused to acknowledge its owner without it.

key: 勇闯贵妇社交圈，原来这位威尔先生养狗是为了讨好市政厅的“大人物”，难怪劳师动众。两位贵妇也提供了线索，这个圆球可能遗失在了侵蚀区。
value: After diving headfirst into high-society gossip, you learned that Mr. Will had been keeping the dog to curry favor with an influential figure at City Hall, which explained the excessive fuss. Two socialites also provided a lead: the missing orb might have ended up inside a Devouring Area.

key: 塔可接到另一起报案，说来也巧，是一位侵蚀区的矿工遗失了一个玩具球，根据描述，和威尔先生丢失的那个很像。
value: TACO received another report. Coincidentally, a miner working in the Devouring Area had also lost a toy ball matching the description of Mr. Will's missing one.

key: 矿工承认捡到了玩具球想要据为己有，但他自己也把球弄丢了。
value: The miner admitted he had found the toy ball and intended to keep it for himself, only to lose it afterward.

key: 矿工确认这就是他遗失……哦不，他曾捡到的球。可惜不算拾金不昧。
value: The miner confirmed this was the ball he had lost — well, technically the one he had picked up. So much for turning in lost property.

key: 将“贵重”的玩具球交给塔可，但愿黑厅不用再处理这种哭笑不得的案子了。
value: You handed the "valuable" toy ball over to TACO, hoping the Black Hall wouldn't have to deal with another ridiculous case like this anytime soon.

key: 狗狗又走丢了，而且这次它不认威尔先生手里的玩具球了，只认得最贵的那个球，威尔先生也掷重金买下了最贵的球，重新成为主人。
value: The dog went missing again, and this time it no longer recognized the toy ball in Mr. Will's hand. It only responded to the most expensive one instead. In the end, Mr. Will bought the priciest ball available and once again reclaimed his status as the dog's owner.

key: 生长于巨坑地上露天环境下的植被，为大侵蚀后诞生的新品种。其具备复杂的变色功能以及强大的蓄水能力，一般用于食材补充。
受到侵蚀而生长怪异的蕈类植物，异常的肥大且晶莹剔透。
value: A bizarre fungus mutated by Devour, unnaturally swollen and crystal clear in appearance.

key: 泽尔联合进行侵蚀区建造时会用到的元件，但不知道为何被遗弃了。
value: Components used by Zelle Complex during construction projects within Devouring Areas, though for unknown reasons they were abandoned here.

key: 塔可将天线杖刺向地面，造成创生伤害并获得涌能通量
value: TACO drives her Antenna Staff into the ground, dealing Genesis DMG and gaining Surgeflux Energy.

key: 塔可将天线杖向下戳刺，快速下落到地面，造成X%创生伤害，命中时获得30点涌能通量。。
value: TACO drives her Antenna Staff downward and plunges rapidly to the ground, dealing X% Genesis DMG and gaining 30 Surgeflux Energy.

key: 塔可消耗涌能通量呼叫无人机群支援，造成多段创生伤害。
value: TACO consumes Surgeflux Energy to call in a drone swarm for support, dealing multiple instances of Genesis DMG.

key: 塔可消耗100点涌能通量，呼叫无人机群向自身前方进行多段激光轰击，造成X%创生伤害。
value: TACO consumes 100 Surgeflux Energy to call in a drone swarm that unleashes multiple instances of laser strikes in front of her, dealing X% Genesis DMG.

key: 塔可呼叫无人机群支援，造成多段创生伤害，之后无人机会持续向敌人投放飞弹。
value: TACO calls in a drone swarm for support, dealing multiple instances of Genesis DMG. The drones then continue launching missiles at enemies.

key: 塔可使用最终手段！呼叫无人机群投放大量飞弹对敌人造成X%创生伤害。无人机会持续向敌人投放飞弹，造成X%创生伤害并降低敌人X%防御，持续X秒。无人机持续X秒，换人后依然有效。最终手段！冷却时间20秒。
value: TACO uses her Ultimate Measure! Calls in a drone swarm to launch a massive missile barrage, dealing X% Genesis DMG. The drones continue launching missiles, dealing X% Genesis DMG and reducing enemy DEF by X% for Xs. The drones remain active for Xs and persist even after switching characters. Final Measure! Cooldown: 20s.

key: 塔可在队伍中时，血瓶会持续回复。塔可呼叫的飞弹命中时降低敌人的防御。
value: While TACO is in the squad, HP Potions regenerate over time. Missiles called in by TACO reduce enemy DEF on hit.

key: 塔可在队伍中时，每X秒回复1个血瓶。塔可呼叫的飞弹命中时降低敌人X%防御，持续X秒。
value: While TACO is in the squad, restores 1 HP Potion every Xs. Missiles called in by TACO reduce enemy DEF by X% for Xs on hit.

抱着试试看的心情，我启动了那只机械猫，希望它能帮助我找到适合作为宠物的存在。
value: On a whim, I activated the mechanical cat, hoping it could help me find something suitable to keep as a pet.

key: 经历了一场战斗，我开始怀疑此行的最终目标或许也是一只蚀生体。但此时除了前进，也别无他法。
value: After surviving a fierce battle, I began to suspect that the true objective of this journey might itself have been a Devourborne. But by then, there was no choice left except to keep moving forward.

key: 机械猫在一处角落停下，而它找到的居然是一只奇怪的小虫子。它真的能作为宠物吗？
value: The mechanical cat stopped in a corner and what it found was a strange little bug. Could that really count as a pet?

key: 我目击到了一对因礼物而闹不和的情侣。一方为挽回伤心的爱人，委托我为他寻找适合作为宠物的存在，而他为我提供的帮手则是——一只莫名其妙的机械猫。
value: I came across a couple arguing over a gift. One of them, desperate to win back his heartbroken partner, hired me to help find a suitable pet. And the assistant he provided me with was... a bizarre mechanical cat.

key: 我在前进的路上遇到了一个多藏起来的工作人员，据她所说，前方路上有着十分可怕的生物……
value: While making my way forward, I ran into a staff member hiding nearby. According to her, some terrifying creature was waiting further ahead.

key: 我带着那只“宠物”与那对情侣会和。希望他们对接下来将要看到的东西不要感到过分惊讶。
value: I reunited with the couple while carrying that so-called "pet" with me. Hopefully they weren't too shocked by what they were about to see.

key: 出乎我的意料，对方似乎对我带来的“宠物”十分满意，他们带着那只我带来的小宠物，朝自己幸福的生活奔去……
value: To my surprise, they seemed absolutely thrilled with the "pet" I brought them. Carrying the little creature with them, the couple happily ran off toward their future together...

key: 在梦境中跌入深海，海水冰寒刺骨，冻结血液。若还能睁开逐渐被冰晶覆盖的双眸，会看见有一束绿光，在海渊深处隐没。
value: In a dream, you sink into the deep sea, where the freezing water cuts through you like ice, numbing the blood in your veins. If you can still force your eyes open beneath the spreading frost of crystalline ice, you'll catch a glimpse of a green light fading away in the depths of the abyss.

key: 在睁开双眼之前，往往最容易从一个梦境迭向另一个梦境，在潜藏于内心深处的欲望间挣扎沉溺，直到被意志编制的网打捞，重回现实……
value: Before the eyes ever open, it's easiest to slip from one dream into another, struggling and sinking through desires buried deep within the heart, until the net woven by your will pulls you back to reality...

key: 在奥鲁姆要塞的时间里，除了工作任务之外，我还见到了许多值得一说的人和事……
value: During my time in Orum Bastion, beyond the work and missions were people and stories worth remembering.

key: 你们在莉特莉丝的帮助下摆脱了记者的追击，却没想到莉特莉丝也是一位记者。作为欺骗的补偿，莉特莉丝打算请你们吃饭。
value: With Lictlether's help, you managed to shake off the reporters chasing you, only to discover that Lictlether herself was also a reporter. To make up for deceiving you, she offered to treat everyone to a meal.

key: 你和何雨莲乘坐全地形运载车前往三号采掘基地。
value: You and LIAN traveled to Extraction Site No. 3 aboard an all-terrain transport vehicle.

key: 清晨，你们还没睡醒，黑厅干员塔可就奉命前来，接你们去找何雨莲会合。
value: Early in the morning, before any of you were fully awake, Black Hall Agent TACO arrived under orders to escort you to meet up with LIAN.

key: 向黑厅司机出示了许可证后，成功搭乘前往侵蚀区的全地形运载车。
value: After presenting your permit to the Black Hall driver, you successfully boarded the all-terrain transport vehicle headed for the Devouring Area.

key: 营地即将失守，受何雨莲嘱托，你们必须保护非战斗人员转移到安全地点。
value: The camp was on the verge of collapse. Following LIAN's instructions, you were tasked with escorting the non-combat personnel to safety.

key: 再次“巧遇”莉特莉丝。她希望我们捎她一程，唉，谁让我们吃了她一顿大餐呢。
value: You "coincidentally" ran into Lictlether again. She asked for a ride, and honestly… after she treated you all to such a huge meal, it was hard to refuse.

key: 你在奥鲁姆要塞意外发现了一名同属侵蚀管理局的研究员，他给了你一瓶古怪的注射用药剂，声称可以在你受伤时救你一命。
value: While in Orum Bastion, you unexpectedly encountered a researcher from the E.Z.C, who handed you a strange injectable serum, claiming it could save your life if you were seriously injured.

key: 因为裂隙不稳定，黑厅的灾害对策部需要更多的人投入战斗。放心，黑厅不会亏待你们。
value: With the Rift growing increasingly unstable, the Black Hall's Disaster Response Department needs more hands on the front line. Don't worry, the Black Hall takes care of its own.

key: 蚀瀑组织遗留在某处实验室的储存器，上面刻着蚀瀑的标记，其中的内容暂时无法破解，可能需要一个对此很了解的人才能破解其中的内容。
value: A storage device left behind in a certain laboratory by Erosion Cascade. It bears the mark of Erosion Cascade, but its contents cannot currently be deciphered. It may require someone deeply familiar with the organization to crack the data within.

key: 蚀瀑组织遗留在某处的文件，上面有着蚀瀑的标记，其中的内容用特殊文字加密，暂时无法破解，可能需要一个对此很了解的人才能破解其中的内容。
value: A document left behind somewhere by Erosion Cascade. It bears the mark of Erosion Cascade, and its contents are encrypted in a special script that cannot currently be deciphered. It may require someone deeply familiar with the organization to crack the data within.

key: 在还未完全修建好的泽尔防线东面，盘踞着奥鲁姆要塞最近也是最大的威胁——因弗内斯侵蚀区。
value: East of the still-incomplete Zelle Defense Line lies Orum Bastion's nearest — and greatest — threat: the Inverness Devouring Area.

key: 在“岩角”进攻奥鲁姆要塞的事件中，两个要塞的御能者曾经在这里共同构建防线、并肩作战……但如今那段历史已经渐渐被人忘却。
value: During the "Rockhead" assault on Orum Bastion, Attuners from both bastions once built a defense line here and fought side by side... but that history is slowly fading into obscurity.

key: 臭名昭著的国际佣兵组织“夜游鬼”竟然潜藏在此地。他们似乎将这里改造成了一个临时仓库和实验室，不知谋划着什么肮脏的勾当。
value: The infamous international mercenary group, the "Nightstalker," is hiding here of all places. They seem to have turned the site into a temporary warehouse and laboratory for some shady operation.

key: 秘密就像裹满糖霜的毒剂。有时，人需要收起自己的好奇心。
value: Secrets are poison coated in sugar. Sometimes, curiosity is best left buried.

key: 穿过漫长的通道，机械的大门为你敞开，似乎有什么在指引着你前进……
沉睡的机械战士被唤醒，穿过火线与屏障，破损的机器为你提供前进的线索……
value: A dormant mechanical warrior awakens. Through gunfire and barriers, broken machines leave behind clues to guide your way forward...

key: 使用血瓶后，持续Xs 提升黄的属性伤害X%
value: After using an HP Potion, Blitz Attribute DMG increases by X% for Xs.

key: 使用血瓶后，持续Xs 提升蓝的属性伤害X%
value: After using an HP Potion, Technique Attribute DMG increases by X% for Xs.

value: Healing amount is reduced by X%, but additionally restores HP every second for Xs equal to (X% Max HP + X). Values shown are based on 0.1s recovery intervals.

value: Healing received is reduced by X%, but using an HP Potion increases Crit by X% for Xs.

value: If Support Energy is full when using an HP Potion, DMG Bonus increases by X% for Xs.

key: 使用血瓶时若满血，，持续X秒增加攻击X%
value: If HP is full when using an HP Potion, ATK increases by X% for Xs.

key: 搜寻时空奇点的行动并不顺利。队员们抱怨之际，你看到了一只奇怪的蚀生体……
value: The search for the Spatiotemporal Singularity had not been going smoothly. As the squad complained among themselves, you spotted a strange Devourborne...

key: 你发现时空奇点在一只蚀生体的身上，决定追上它一探究竟。
value: You discovered that the Spatiotemporal Singularity was embedded within a Devourborne and decided to pursue it to uncover the truth.

key: 适能者们在侵蚀区探索的时候体力是最关键的保障。
奥鲁姆的供能中枢，整座要塞的希望灯塔，在侵蚀的威慑下光芒闪耀。
value: Orum's central power core and the beacon of hope for the entire bastion. Its light still shines defiantly beneath the threat of Devour.

key: ‘邓肯裂隙’，距要塞不过数千公里，随时可能吞噬城内的百万市民。
value: The "Duncan Rift," located only a few thousand kilometers from the bastion, could swallow the city's millions of citizens at any moment.

key: 侵蚀极其严重的区域，布满了黑质和其衍生物，人类的绝对禁区。
value: An area suffering from extreme Devour, filled with Tenebrium and its derivatives. An absolute forbidden zone for humanity.

key: 作为侵蚀管理局的蚀务官，要解决一切和侵蚀相关的问题。为此，不断见证和解决是提升自己最直接的途径。
value: As the Supervisor of the E.Z.C, it is your duty to resolve all matters related to Devour. To that end, witnessing and confronting incidents firsthand is the most direct path to growth.

key: 某种未知物种，似乎是虫类。不知为什么给人一种不寒而栗的感觉……把这个作为宠物给那个求爱的男人吧。
value: An unknown species that appears to be some kind of insect. For some reason, just looking at it sends a chill down your spine. Maybe this would make the perfect "pet" for that lovesick guy.

key: 一个闪闪发光的圆球，据说是属于上流人士的玩具。上流人士的狗……的玩具。
value: A sparkling little orb said to belong to some upper-class elite. More specifically, it's the toy of an upper-class elite's dog.

key: 只生长于侵蚀区的奇特植物，透着晶体质感的血红色昭示其具有剧毒，但在煮熟后仍旧可以正常食用。
value: A strange plant that grows only within Devouring Areas. Its crystal-like crimson appearance hints at its deadly toxicity, though it becomes edible once thoroughly cooked.

key: 受侵蚀影响而外形怪异的蕈菌，菌冠晶莹剔透，宛如宝石，需经过长时间的高温烹煮才可食用。
value: A fungus warped by Devour, with a gem-like translucent cap. It must be boiled at high temperatures for a long time before it can be safely eaten.

key: 附着在岩壁上的蛹壳，成因似乎与蚀生体有关，内部的物质能作为烹饪佐料使用。
value: A cocoon shell attached to a rock wall, seemingly connected to Devourborne. The substance inside can be used as a cooking seasoning.

key: 奥鲁姆城通用的存储货舱，偶尔会从运输载具上掉落，能在各种意想不到的地方看见它们的身影。
value: A standard cargo container used throughout Orum City. They occasionally fall off transport vehicles, which is why they can turn up in the strangest places.

key: 被侵蚀污染加固后的岩石，虽然表面布满裂痕，但内部岩芯的硬度与强度近乎金属。
value: Rock reinforced through Devour contamination. Though its surface is covered in cracks, the core inside is nearly as hard and durable as metal.

key: 闪闪发亮的矿石，可被用于制作各种装饰品，具有很高的商业价值。希望收到它的人可以就此满足。
value: A glittering ore that can be crafted into all kinds of decorative items. Highly valuable on the market. Hopefully, the person receiving it will be satisfied with just one.

key: 闪闪发亮的矿石，不管拥有多少都不嫌多。希望收到它的人不要太贪得无厌。
value: A glittering ore. No matter how many you have, it never feels like enough. Hopefully, whoever receives it won't get too greedy.

key: 闪闪发亮的矿石，即便再怎么有价值，也不应该囤积太多。希望收到它的人会因自己的贪心而遭受报应。
value: A glittering ore. No matter how valuable it may be, hoarding too much of it can only end badly. Hopefully, whoever receives it gets what they deserve for their greed.

key: 你收到了洛夕的邀请，对方希望和你一同去蟹屋用餐。
value: You received an invitation from ROCHE, who wanted to have dinner with you at the Crab House.

key: 你同洛夕在蟹屋用餐，却发现菜品大失水准，询问老板后发现对方在尝试研究新的菜谱。你和洛夕决定帮助老板研究菜谱，并帮助他寻找所需的食材。
value: While dining with ROCHE at the Crab House, you noticed the food quality had dropped significantly. After speaking with the owner, you learned he had been experimenting with new recipes. You and ROCHE decided to help him develop the dishes and gather the ingredients he needed.

key: 一个契尔斯通员工手中正好有你所需的食材，但为了获得它，你必须帮对方取得一个掉落的货物。
value: A Keystone employee happened to have the ingredients you needed, but in exchange, you had to help recover some lost cargo.

key: 你将掉落的货物交给了契尔斯通的员工，并得到了所需的食材。
value: You returned the lost cargo to the Keystone employee and received the ingredient you needed in return.

key: 你收集了所有的食材，老板对你表示了感谢，并承诺会给你们特殊的优惠。
value: After gathering all the ingredients, the owner thanked you sincerely and promised to give you special discounts in the future.

key: 你看到一个正在和同事争吵的契尔斯通雇员，询问之后得知对方为了加入一个名为“越拼越多”的基金会，急需拉一个人新人入会。为了调查这个组织，选择前去参加这个组织的宣讲会。
value: You came across a Keystone employee arguing with a coworker. After asking around, you learned they were desperately trying to recruit a new member into an organization called "More In, More Out." Hoping to investigate the group, you decided to attend one of their recruitment seminars.

key: 你见到了“越拼越多”基金会的负责人，对方通过宣讲，让那个契尔斯通雇员更加坚定了自己加入“越拼越多”的念头，但负责人借口让他补交更多的费用。
value: You met the person in charge of the "More In, More Out" Foundation. After listening to the presentation, the Keystone employee became even more determined to join, only for the organizer to demand additional fees under various excuses.

key: 补交费用后，负责人用另外一个借口让他补交更多的费用。
value: After paying the extra fee, the organizer came up with yet another excuse to demand even more money.

key: 补交费用后，负责人打算找借口离开，但马上被黑厅的人拦住并逮捕，这场闹剧终于结束，而那个被骗的契尔斯通员工也不得不回到现实。
value: After collecting the additional payment, the organizer tried to make an excuse and leave, only to be stopped and arrested by the Black Hall personnel on the spot. The farce finally came to an end, and the scammed Keystone employee was forced to face reality.

key: 你不打算继续补交费用，并联系了黑厅的人，但你的行为引起了负责人的警觉，对方着急地离开了现场，而那个契尔斯通员工也能接受自己被骗的现实。
value: You decided not to pay any more fees and contacted the Black Hall instead. However, your actions alerted the organizer, who quickly fled the scene. Even so, the Keystone employee was finally able to accept that he had been scammed.

key: 你遇到了一名神情焦急的工作人员，对方正在寻找自己的另外三名同事，似乎有十分重要的事情要与她们商量。你答应要帮助她找到同事，并让她们回到基地。
value: You encountered a visibly anxious staff member searching for her three missing coworkers. Apparently, she had something extremely important to discuss with them. You agreed to help track them down and bring them back to the base.

key: 你遇到了一名正在收集石头的工作人员，为了让她快点回到营地，你决定帮忙收集对方所需的石头。
value: You came across a staff member collecting rocks. Hoping to help her return to camp sooner, you decided to gather the stones she needed on her behalf.

key: 你将找到的石头交给了那名热衷于收集石头的工作人员，对方满意地返回基地。
value: You handed over the rocks you collected to the staff member obsessed with rock collecting, and she happily returned to the base.

key: 你遇到了一名正在忙着标记区域蚀生体的工作人员，为了加快她的工作进程，你决定清理一下这附近的蚀生体。
value: You encountered a staff member busy marking Devourborne in the area. To speed up her work, you decided to clear out the nearby Devourborne yourself.

key: 你清理完了附近的蚀生体，帮助工作人员完成了自己的工作，对方满意地返回基地。
value: After eliminating the nearby Devourborne, you helped the staff member finish her task, and she returned to the base satisfied.

key: 你遇到了一名正在偷懒的工作人员，休息被打扰到的她倍感无趣地返回基地。
value: You encountered a staff member slacking off. With her break interrupted, she reluctantly headed back to the base.

key: 所有的工作人员都返回了基地，但众人的讨论并不和善，关键时刻，你的妙语让众人敞开心扉，道出了真实想法的众人终于停止的争吵。
value: All of the staff eventually returned to the base, though the atmosphere among them remained tense. At a critical moment, your well-timed words helped everyone open up. Once they finally spoke honestly about their feelings, the argument at last came to an end.

key: 你找到了所有的工作人员，并准备返回基地。
value: You managed to locate all of the missing staff members and prepared to head back to the base.

key: 你遇到了一名自称是蚀生体语言学者的人，对方称自己找到了一只具有语言能力的蚀生体，并请求你陪同前往洞穴深处，寻找这个神奇的蚀生体。
value: You encountered someone claiming to be a "Devourborne linguist," who insisted on having discovered a Devourborne capable of speaking and asking you to go deeper into the cave in search of this miraculous creature together.

key: 你们似乎已经十分接近那个会说话的蚀生体了。
value: It seemed you were getting very close to the so-called talking Devourborne.

key: 在洞穴的深处，你们见到了另外一名学者，对方正在发出自创的“蚀生体语”，而这正是“会说话的蚀生体”的真面目，得知真相的蚀生体语言学者感到十分的崩溃。
value: Deep within the cave, you encountered another scholar making strange noises in a self-invented "Devourborne language." That turned out to be the truth behind the "talking Devourborne," and the self-proclaimed linguist was utterly devastated upon learning the truth.

key: 你遇到了一个正在自言自语的员工，并从她口中得知另一个工作人员最近的举止十分奇怪，现在则不知为何离开了基地。为了确保对方的安全，你决定前去寻找对方。
value: You encountered an employee muttering to herself and learned from her that another staff member had recently been acting strangely before suddenly leaving the base for unknown reasons. Concerned for her safety, you decided to go look for her.

key: 你遇到了那位举止奇怪的员工，并发现对方居然在尝试用十分不靠谱的方法成为一名适能者。
value: You encountered the oddly behaving employee and discovered that she was attempting to become a Devivor through some extremely questionable methods.

key: 你跟上了那位举止奇怪的员工，并发现对方正在尝试通过搬运远超自身极限的货物来激活适能者体质，接着便因无法承受而昏了过去。你决定帮她做出一些改变……
value: You followed the strange employee and found her trying to awaken Devivor powers by carrying cargo far beyond her physical limits before eventually collapsing from the strain. You decided to help her change her ways...

key: 你在对方醒后告诉对方真相，对方在短暂的失落后重新振作，前往了下一个锻炼地点。
value: After she woke up, you told her the truth. Though briefly discouraged, she soon pulled herself together and headed off to her next "training site."

key: 你在对方醒后谎称对方有觉醒适能者体质的迹象，对方激动地前往了下一个锻炼地点。
value: After she woke up, you lied and told her she showed signs of awakening Devivor powers. Thrilled by the news, she eagerly rushed off to her next "training site."

key: 你跟上了那位举止奇怪的员工，并发现对方正在尝试通过面对蚀生体来激活适能者体质，接着便因恐惧而昏了过去。你决定帮她清理这些蚀生体。
value: You followed the strange employee and discovered that she was attempting to awaken Devivor powers by confronting Devourborne head-on. She soon fainted from sheer terror. You decided to clear out the Devourborne for her.

key: 解决了蚀生体后，你决定帮她做出一些改变……
value: After dealing with the Devourborne, you decided to help her change her ways...

key: 你在对方醒后告诉对方真相，对方在短暂的失落后，决定返回基地。
value: After she woke up, you told her the truth. Though briefly discouraged, she ultimately decided to return to the base.

key: 你在对方醒后谎称对方有觉醒适能者体质的迹象，对方在一阵激动后，决定返回基地。
value: After she woke up, you lied and told her she showed signs of awakening Devivor powers. After an excited outburst, she decided to return to the base.

key: 那位想要成为适能者的人回到了基地，但她的性格在你的影响下变得极度自负，并坚信自己已经是一位适能者了。你不知这对她究竟是好是坏……
value: The aspiring Devivor returned to the base, but under your influence, she became extremely arrogant and firmly convinced that she had truly become a Devivor. Whether that was a good thing or not... you couldn't really say.

key: 那位想要成为适能者的人回到了基地，但她的性格在你的影响下变得更加古怪，并尝试用更奇怪的方式成为适能者。你不知这对她究竟是好是坏……
value: The aspiring Devivor returned to the base, but under your influence, she became even stranger and started experimenting with even more bizarre methods to become a Devivor. Whether that was a good thing or not... you couldn't really say.

key: 那位想要成为适能者的人回到了基地，但她的性格在你的影响下变得极度自卑，并接受了自己作为一个普通人的命运。你不知这对她究竟是好是坏……
value: The aspiring Devivor returned to the base, but under your influence, she became deeply insecure and accepted her fate as an ordinary person. Whether that was a good thing or not... you couldn't really say.

key: 你见到有两队对侵蚀持有不同态度的市民正在争吵，原因是他们对现在要塞外真实情况的了解各自不一。为了阻止他们的争吵，你决定前往要塞之外拍摄照片，为他们带回要塞外真实的情况。
value: You came across two groups of civilians arguing over the nature of Devour. The disagreement stemmed from how little each side truly knew about the world beyond the bastion. To settle the dispute, you decided to head outside and take photographs showing the real conditions out there.

key: 你遇到了一些蚀生体，在拍摄照片之前，最好先把它们清除掉。
value: You encountered several Devourborne. Before taking any photos, it was probably best to take them out first.

key: 你为蚀生体们拍了照。照片里闯进了一只小猫，不过这应该无伤大雅。
value: You took photos of the Devourborne. A stray kitten wandered into the shots, though that probably wasn't a big deal.

key: 你为因蚀生体攻击而破损的二号采掘基地拍了照。照片里闯进了一只小猫，不过这应该无伤大雅。
value: You took photos of Extraction Site No. 2 after it had been damaged by a Devourborne attack. A stray kitten wandered into the shots, though that probably wasn't a big deal.

key: 你为一处侵蚀裂隙拍了照。照片里闯进了一只小猫，不过这应该无伤大雅。
value: You took photos of a Devouring Rift. A stray kitten wandered into the shots, though that probably wasn't a big deal.

key: 你将拍好的照片带回给争吵的众人，但众人依旧对这些现状有着不同的理解，继而继续争吵。然而，当有人注意到照片中出现的小猫时，争吵的重心便完全转移到了小猫上，不再对侵蚀关心的他们随即四散离去。
value: You brought the photos back to the arguing crowd, but everyone still interpreted the situation differently, and the argument continued. However, once someone noticed the kitten in the photos, the entire discussion shifted toward the cat instead. Losing interest in arguing about Devour, the crowd eventually dispersed.

key: 黑市流通的装备，源自某种先进设备的拆解件。
value: Equipment circulated on the black market. Salvaged components from an unidentified advanced device.

key: 泽尔联合赫菲斯托斯实验室第六代装备套组。
value: A sixth-generation equipment set developed by the Hephaestus Laboratory of Zelle Complex.

key: 泽尔联合以黑质净化为目的研发的实验性维生装置。
value: An experimental life-support device developed by Zelle Complex for Tenebrium purification.

key: 泽尔联合以黑质净化为目的研发的实验性过滤装置。
value: An experimental filtration device developed by Zelle Complex for Tenebrium purification.

key: 泽尔联合以黑质净化为目的研发的实验性探测装置。
value: An experimental detection device developed by Zelle Complex for Tenebrium purification.

key: 泽尔联合以黑质净化为目的研发的实验性增压装置。
value: An experimental pressure-boosting device developed by Zelle Complex for Tenebrium purification.

key: 一条条滨海长街共同构成了海文利区，这里既不像恶土那样时刻面临生存危险，同时又巧妙避开来自中枢区的穷奢极侈。
value: The Havenly District is woven together by its long coastal streets, a place free from the constant survival struggles of the Badlands, yet far removed from the excess and decadence of the Central Hub.

key: 由奥鲁姆海关、黑厅、各大公司共同控制的交通集散地，这里不仅通往奥鲁姆要塞其他城区，也是从海文利区前往侵蚀区的唯一出入口。
value: Controlled jointly by Orum Customs, the Black Hall, and the major corporations, this transportation hub connects the rest of Orum Bastion and serves as the only gateway between the Havenly District and the Devouring Area.

key: 广播塔的所在处，四周散落着已无人查阅的信息。
value: The site of the broadcast tower, surrounded by scattered information no one reads anymore.

key: 连接中庭与底层仓库的栈道，隐约能够听到从隔壁传来的电梯运作声。
value: A catwalk linking the central atrium to the lower warehouse. Faint elevator sounds drift in from somewhere nearby.

key: 早已弃用的车间，如今不过是一颗未跳动的心脏。
value: A workshop long abandoned, now nothing more than a motionless heart.

key: 楼顶的空旷斜道，可以运送大型器械，同时也告诉来到这里的人：你即将离开塔楼。
value: The wide, sloping path atop the building is used to transport heavy equipment, but it also serves as a reminder to all who pass through: you're about to leave the tower behind.

key: 鲜有人知的隐蔽过道，曾经被用作应急通道使用。
value: A hidden passage known to few, once used as an emergency escape route.

key: 角色通过援护技登场时，可获得特殊的增益效果。
value: Characters gain special buffs when entering battle via Support Skills.

key: 角色可通过攻击敌人等方式获得额外的【共振】能量，从而通过消耗共振能量，以获得特殊的增益效果。
value: Characters can gain additional [Resonance] Energy through actions such as attacking enemies, then consume it to gain special buff effects.

key:
你向营地内的工作人员询问车辙痕迹，却一无所获。
另外，对方提醒了你们，现在可以装备上【调制器】，以应对接下来可能面临的挑战。

副本系统内置有基础移动训练模块，借此鼓励御能者们夯实基础，完成训练的挑战者会得到丰厚的补给奖励。
训练内容为移动跳跃，完成训练挑战后，可获得一定数量的作战经验。

副本系统能够根据使用者的作战经历构建战斗场景，御能者们能在战斗中吸取宝贵的作战经验，完成训练的挑战者会获得丰厚的补给奖励。
训练内容为战斗挑战，完成训练挑战后，可获得一定数量的技能升级材料。

副本系统能够根据使用者的作战经历构建战斗场景，御能者们能在战斗中吸取宝贵的作战经验，完成训练的挑战者会获得丰厚的补给奖励。
训练内容为战斗挑战，以战斗挑战为完成训练挑战后，可获得一定数量的技能升级材料。

副本系统能够根据使用者的作战经历构建战斗场景，御能者们能在战斗中吸取宝贵的作战经验，完成训练的挑战者会获得丰厚的补给奖励。
训练内容为战斗挑战，完成训练挑战后，可获得一定数量的校准材料。
曾拥有繁荣文明的类地行星，现在饱受侵蚀摧残。
value: Once home to a thriving civilization, this terrestrial planet now suffers under the devastation of Devour.

key:
随着裂隙一起出现的神秘物质。
会侵蚀生命体并将其变成恐怖的怪物。
value:
A mysterious substance that appeared alongside the Rifts.
It devours living beings and transforms them into horrific monsters.

key: 突然出现在哈洛星球的空间裂隙，似乎通往另外一个世界。
value: Spatial rifts that suddenly appeared across Halo, seemingly leading to another world.

key: 为了抵抗侵蚀而成立的机构，以保护人类文明为己任。
value: An organization founded to fight back against Devour, dedicated to preserving human civilization.

key: 天生对“黑质”具有抗性、身体强度异于常人的特殊人群。
value: A rare group born with natural resistance to "Tenebrium," possessing physical abilities far beyond ordinary humans.

key: 构战回廊中产出的核心材料可用于装备打造和升级。
value: Core materials obtained from the Battle of Corridor can be used to craft and upgrade gear.

key: 升级校准可获得高价值的属性和技能，用以提升角色实力。
value: Upgrading Calibration unlocks powerful stats and skills to strengthen your characters.

key: 装备等级提升，镶嵌孔位的等级和数量也会随之提升。
value: As the gear levels up, the number and level of socket slots increase as well.

key: 套装部件越多，套装的专属特性等级就越高。
value: The more set pieces equipped, the higher the level of the set's exclusive effects.

key: 面对强大的敌人，升级角色和技能是最为有效的制胜策略。
value: Against powerful enemies, upgrading characters and skills is the most effective path to victory.

key:
自由搭配各类磁盘，可为角色提供丰富的额外特性。
构建多变的战术选择和战斗风格是取胜的关键。
value:
Mix and match different Disks to grant characters a wide range of bonus traits.
Flexible builds and adaptive combat styles are the key to winning.

key: 相同频域的角色组队能发挥出更强的力量，快去试试吧！
value: Characters sharing the same Frequency can unleash even greater power together. Give it a try!

key: 释放援护技时，退场角色中枢心相的增伤会在全队共享。

value: A hybrid Devourborne created from a communication device fused with a massive beast. Despite its enormous body, it attacks with shocking speed and crushing force far beyond normal understanding. Even enhanced by Devour Energy, biological and mechanical lifeforms should not be able to integrate this perfectly. Yet from the mechanical chips embedded deep in the bone and the sutured seams along the edges of the body, one can glimpse fragments of a terrible truth from the past...

key: 由一位颇具探索精神的研究者所研制的愈合注射器，具有提升伤害的附加剂效，但由于高效部分沉淀在药剂底部，该剂效只有在最后一次疗愈时才能生效。因其并不完美的使用效果，该款注射器被许多人评价为为半成品，而要我说，这些人身上还是缺了些“探索精神”。
value: A Healing Injector developed by a highly inquisitive researcher. It comes with an additive effect that boosts damage output, but because the active compounds settle at the bottom of the vial, the effect only activates on the final heal. Due to its less-than-perfect usability, many people dismiss this injector as unfinished. Personally, I'd say those people simply lack a proper sense of "exploration."

key: 结合契尔斯通公司提供的野外数据所研制的愈合注射器，旨在减少于侵蚀区进行行动时所收到的伤害，使用后能够提升使用者的防御力，并规避所受到的环境伤害。据悉，契尔斯通计划将该注射器发放给全体侵蚀区工作人员，并在工资条上增添一项“安全保障”的扣款条目。
value: A Healing Injector developed using field data provided by Keystone. Designed to reduce damage sustained during operations in Devouring Areas, it increases the user's defence and protects against environmental damage after use. Rumor has it Keystone plans to issue these injectors to all Devouring Area personnel, along with a brand-new "Safety Assurance" deduction conveniently added to their paychecks.

key: 岩茧是在奥鲁姆当地侵蚀区出现的一种“漂浮着的生物化石”。该矿石出现于岩角死亡后，由其生物性的岩块自发汇聚而成。
value: Rockoons are a type of "floating biological fossil" found within Orum's local Devouring Areas. These minerals form after Rockhead dies, as the organism's living stone fragments naturally converge together.

key: 由侵蚀管理局研制的愈合注射器，内含能够快速愈合伤口的疗愈药剂，作为标准装备分发给各御能者。只具有回复生命值这一基础效果，无其他附加剂效。作为标准款的注射器，它的命运已不言而喻，只是当你踏上更远的路途后，还请不要忘记这最初的起点。
value: A Healing Injector developed by the E.Z.C. It contains a restorative vial capable of rapidly healing wounds and is issued to all Attuners as standard equipment. Its only effect is HP recovery, with no additional additives. As the standard model injector, its fate is self-explanatory. Still, no matter how far your journey takes you, don't forget where it all began.

key: 由侵蚀管理局研制的愈合注射器，以标准注射器为模板研发的改进版本。具有提升疗愈能力的附加剂效，注射器的疗愈值增加。于任何研究领域都能见到的以简单数字叠加为思路的产品，人类基础数学思维的具象化体现。
value: A Healing Injector developed by the E.Z.C, an upgraded version based on the Regular Injector design. It includes an additive effect that enhances healing potency, increasing the amount restored per use. A product built on the timeless research philosophy of "just add bigger numbers" — a perfect embodiment of humanity's most fundamental understanding of mathematics.

key: 由侵蚀管理局研制的愈合注射器，以标准注射器为模板研发的改进版本。具有提升能量获取的附加剂效，使用后能让使用者获得一定量的适能。这种药剂还具有提神的效果，但还请不要将其视为提神保健品进行滥用，由此产生的后果本人概不负责。

key:
在空中可直接投掷【红莲短剑】攻击，造成奇袭伤害，最多存在两把。
若周围存在红莲短剑，则可进行瞬移，并追加【红莲绽放】，造成超限伤害。
value:
While airborne, throw a [Crimson Lotus Dagger] to attack, dealing Ambush DMG. Up to two daggers can exist at once.
If Crimson Lotus Daggers are present nearby, you can teleport and trigger [Crimson Lotus Bloom], dealing Limitbreak DMG.

key:
【红莲】状态下，进行上挑攻击，造成奇袭伤害并投掷【红莲短剑】；
若周围存在红莲短剑，则可进行瞬移，并追加【红莲绽放EX】进行至多四段斩击，造成超限伤害。
value:
In [Crimson Lotus] state, perform an Upward Attack that deals Ambush DMG and throws a [Crimson Lotus Dagger].
If Crimson Lotus Daggers are present nearby, you can teleport and follow up with [Crimson Lotus Bloom EX], unleashing up to four instances of slashes that deal Limitbreak DMG.

value: An encrypted ID badge containing personal identity data. Its clearance level is exceptionally high, allowing unrestricted access throughout Orum Bastion.

key: 看上去与其他石头没有区别，但任何物品的附加值都是由人所赋予的，不是吗？
value: It looks no different from any ordinary stone at first glance. But then again, isn't the value of anything determined by the people who assign meaning to it?

key: 黑厅为巡卫组配备的标准供能单元。设计理念侧重稳定与持久，能够满足长时间巡逻的能源需求，其输出功率专为常规勤务优化，不适合高烈度连续作战。
value: A standard power supply unit issued to Black Hall Patrol Units. Designed with stability and endurance in mind, it can support long-term patrol operations. Its output is optimized for routine duties and is not suited for sustained high-intensity combat.

key: 黑厅为巡卫组配备的基础防护面罩。优化了长时间佩戴的舒适性与基础密闭性，可有效过滤环境粉尘及标准浓度黑质粒子，面对高强度侵蚀环境需额外防护。
value: A basic protective mask issued to Black Hall Patrol Units. Optimized for long-term comfort and basic airtightness, it effectively filters environmental dust and standard concentrations of Tenebrium particles. Additional protection is required in high-intensity Devour environments.

key: 黑厅为巡卫组配备的导航与记录仪。集成路径记录、区域标记及短距通讯功能，在已测绘稳定区域内定位可靠，于强干扰或未标记环境中的精度会下降。
value: A navigation and recording device issued to Black Hall Patrol Units. Integrates route tracking, area marking, and short-range communication functions. Provides reliable positioning within mapped and stable regions, though accuracy decreases in heavily disrupted or unmapped environments.

key: 黑厅为巡卫组配备的标准辅助增强模块。激活后可平稳提升使用者的基础力量与神经反应速度，旨在应对常规冲突，设计侧重于持续性与稳定性。
value: A standard support enhancement module issued to Black Hall Patrol Units. Once activated, it steadily enhances the user's physical strength and neural response speed. Designed primarily for handling routine conflicts, with an emphasis on reliability and sustained performance.

key: 黑市流通的改装供能单元。由多个来源不明的二手部件拼合而成，输出功率存在波动，可满足基础作战的短时能源需求，但连续高负荷运行时存在过载风险。
value: A modified power supply unit circulated on the black market. Assembled from secondhand parts of questionable origin, its output fluctuates unpredictably. It can satisfy short-term energy demands for basic combat, though continuous high-load operation carries a significant risk of overload.

key: 黑市流通的翻新防护面罩。基础结构经过多次修补与强化，滤芯采用非标混合材料，对常规侵蚀环境提供基础防护，密闭性与长期可靠性低于正规制式装备。
value: A refurbished protective mask circulated on the black market. Its basic structure has undergone repeated repairs and reinforcement, while the filter core uses non-standard composite materials. It offers basic protection against ordinary Devour environments, though its sealing capability and long-term reliability fall short of official-grade equipment.

key: 黑市流通的改装定位仪。核心传感器件来自淘汰的军用或民用设备，信号接收与解算能力不完整，在已知稳定区域能提供基础导向功能，定位精度与抗干扰能力较弱。
value: A modified locator device circulated on the black market. Its core sensor components were salvaged from decommissioned military or civilian equipment. Signal reception and processing capabilities are incomplete, allowing only basic navigation in stable, known regions. Positioning accuracy and anti-interference performance are relatively poor.

key: 黑市流通的激素调控模块。通过注射混合激素与神经刺激剂，可在短时间内提升使用者的机体反应与力量水平，效果结束后会出现不同程度的疲劳与感官钝化现象。
value: A hormone regulation module circulated on the black market. By injecting a blend of hormones and neural stimulants, it temporarily enhances the user's reflexes and physical strength. Once the effects wear off, varying degrees of fatigue and sensory dullness will occur.

key: 由重型载具动力核心改造的供能装置。移除限制器后能以部件加速损耗为代价，短时输出超高功率，为临时搭载的高耗能设备供能。
value: A power supply device converted from the core of a heavy transport vehicle. With its limiters removed, it can deliver extremely high short-term output at the cost of accelerated component degradation, supplying temporary power to high-consumption equipment.

key: 由多种战术镜片拼合而成的复合目镜。集成微光、热感与震动感知模块，可在无光或强干扰环境中有效捕捉并勾勒生物目标的轮廓与轨迹。
value: Composite goggles assembled from multiple tactical lenses. Integrates low-light, thermal, and vibration detection modules, allowing them to effectively detect and outline the contours and movement paths of biological targets in darkness or heavily disrupted environments.

key: 可主动激活的伪装式诱骗装置。启动后能够模拟特定生命体征或高能量源的信号特征，用以吸引、误导或干扰周边蚀生体的感知系统，从而创造战术时机或转移威胁。
value: An actively deployable camouflage decoy device. Once activated, it can simulate the signal patterns of specific lifeforms or high-energy sources, attracting, misleading, or disrupting the perception systems of nearby Devourborne to create tactical openings or divert threats.

key: 集成数据存储与实时分析功能的便携设备。可记录并比对战场数据，依据历史信息对已知类型目标的行动模式与结构弱点进行快速标记与推算。
value: A portable device integrating data storage and real-time analysis functions. It can record and compare battlefield data, rapidly identifying and calculating behavioral patterns and structural weaknesses of known target types based on historical records.

key: 海文利初代仿生学产品。其运作机制模拟了发光水母的能量转换过程，可在中低浓度侵蚀环境中稳定过滤并转化环境能量，为系统提供平稳、洁净的基础供能。
value: Havenly's first-generation bionics product. Its operating mechanism imitates the energy conversion process of bioluminescent jellyfish, enabling it to steadily filter and convert environmental energy within low- to medium-level Devour environments, providing stable and clean baseline power to the system.

key: 海文利初代仿生学产品。面罩内层嵌有仿生智能色素细胞，可依据外部能量流强度与光谱变化瞬时调节透光率与滤光波段，在强视觉干扰中有效保护使用者并提取关键信息。
value: Havenly's first-generation bionics product. The inner layer of the mask is embedded with biomimetic intelligent pigment cells capable of instantly adjusting light transmission and filtering wavelengths according to fluctuations in external energy flow and spectral changes, effectively protecting the user from visual interference while extracting critical information.

key: 海文利初代仿生学产品。灵感源于鲸豚与蝙蝠的生物回声定位系统，可通过发射并接收特定频谱的主动声波，穿透视觉盲区，构建基于声学反射的三维环境结构模型。
value: Havenly's first-generation bionics product. Inspired by the biological echolocation systems of whales, dolphins, and bats, it emits and receives active sound waves within specific frequency ranges, penetrating visual blind spots to construct three-dimensional environmental models based on acoustic reflections.

key: 海文利初代仿生学产品。形态与动作模拟蝠鲼在水中的滑翔，能利用压力差实现超乎寻常的静默移动与急速变向，帮助使用者在复杂地形中保持优越的位控能力。
value: Havenly's first-generation bionics product. Its movement and structure imitate the gliding motion of manta rays underwater, using pressure differentials to achieve exceptional silent movement and rapid directional shifts, helping the user maintain superior positional control in complex terrain.

key: 海文利为集团内部安防组配备的标准供能单元。采用高集成模块化设计，在保障长时间稳定运行的同时具备快速响应能力，其输出特性专为常规安防任务优化。
value: A standard power supply unit issued to Havenly Group's internal security teams. Featuring a highly integrated modular design, it ensures stable long-term operation while retaining rapid response capabilities. Its output profile is optimized specifically for standard security operations.

key: 海文利为安防组配备的战术防护面罩。除标准密闭与过滤功能外，集成了热信号分析模块，可依据目标热特征实时评估威胁等级，并对高危险目标进行视觉标记与预警提示。
value: A tactical protective mask issued by Havenly to security teams. In addition to standard sealing and filtration functions, it integrates a thermal signature analysis module capable of assessing threat levels in real time based on target heat signatures, while visually marking and warning against high-risk targets.

key: 海文利为集团内部安防组配备的态势感知与调度单元。集成区域环境监控、加密通讯与战术标记功能，能够对安防区域内的动态事件进行记录与信息统合，并为团队提供基础战术指引。
value: A situational awareness and coordination unit issued to Havenly Group's internal security teams. Integrates environmental monitoring, encrypted communications, and tactical marking functions, allowing it to record and consolidate dynamic events within secured areas while providing teams with baseline tactical guidance.

key: 海文利为安防组配备的战术协调增强器。激活后提升使用者反应与执行能力，支持与指挥系统实时同步，接收战术指令，强化团队协同效率。
value: A tactical coordination enhancer issued by Havenly to security teams. Once activated, it enhances the user's reflexes and operational efficiency, supporting real-time synchronization with command systems to receive tactical directives and improve overall team coordination.

key:

我们已经蛰伏了太久！

我，玛塔·克洛泽活着只有一个目的：

把蚀生体赶出这个要塞！
夺回我们的家！
value:
Wuerkenians were never meant to become cowards living under someone else's roof!
We've laid low for ten long years!

I, Marta Klose, live for one reason alone:

Drive the Devourborne out of this bastion!
Take back our home!

key:
他曾到过高山，也曾坠入幽谷。

曾被万人敬仰，也背负过污名与谩骂。

无论何时，他如熔炉般炽热的心都不曾动摇。

现在他终于得以安息，

如期望般，随风远行。
value:
He stood atop mountains, and he fell into the deepest valleys.

He was once revered by thousands, and burdened by disgrace and condemnation alike.

Yet through it all, his heart, burning like a furnace, never wavered.

Now, at last, he has found his rest,

and gone with the wind, just as he wished.

key: 破败的大厅中，康拉德的雕像静静矗立，不再受任何人的瞻仰。

key: 堆积的钢锭，原本应当被冶炼成乌尔芬钢的它们，如今则被遗弃，正如被世界遗弃的瓦尔肯人。
value: Stacks of steel ingots that were once meant to be forged into Urfeuerstahl now lay abandoned, just like Wuerkenians abandoned by the world itself.

key: 瓦尔肯人制造的高精密工具，至今仍闪耀着瓦尔肯的骄傲：瓦尔肯工具，永不变质！
value: A high-precision tool crafted by the WUERKEN people, still shining with pride of WUERKEN to this day: WUERKEN tools never degrade!

key: 维持能源节点运作的重要元件，现已无法正常使用。从其精细的做工不难看出曾经瓦尔肯工业的辉煌。
value: A key component once used to maintain the operation of energy nodes, now no longer functional. Its intricate craftsmanship alone speaks volumes about the former glory of WUERKEN industry.

key: 拥有优异力学性能的合金，曾被瓦尔肯人广泛应用于工程结构和高温环境中。目前制造方式已丢失。
value: An alloy with exceptional mechanical properties, once widely used by Wuerkenians in engineering structures and high-temperature environments. The manufacturing process has since been lost.

key: 在何雨莲和克劳迪娅被迫前往参加会议后，众人在等待期间为接下来的行动做准备……
value: After LIAN and Claudia were forced to attend a meeting, everyone used the waiting time to prepare for the upcoming operation...

key: 欢迎抵达奥鲁姆要塞，蚀务官。完成任务解锁权限，可申领专属激励补给。
value: Welcome to the Orum Bastion, EAS Officer. Complete missions to unlock permissions and claim exclusive incentive supplies.

key: 据奥克朗预警系统提示，裂隙的活跃指数正在持续升高，蚀生体将向奥鲁姆要塞方向持续扩散，黑厅人手短缺，现委派侵蚀机动队协助黑厅灾害对策部，完成防卫阻击作战。蚀务官，看你的了。
黑厅行于白昼，我们则漫步长夜。蚀务官，现在有一份仅对你开放的私人委托：清扫周边地区的蚀生体，保障来往旅人的安全。
value: Black Hall moves in daylight, while we walk through endless night. EAS Officer, a private commission has been assigned exclusively to you: eliminate Devourborne in the surrounding areas and ensure the safety of passing travelers.

key: 一首极具瓦尔肯风格的民谣，不知道玛塔会不会唱。
value: A folk song steeped in classic WUERKEN style. Wonder if MARTA knows how to sing it.

key: 记录着过去的小纸条，彼时的瓦尔肯还流行着传纸条的传统。
value: A small note recording moments from the past. Back then, passing handwritten notes was still a popular tradition in WUERKEN.

key: 格尼森氏族的人留下的笔记，记载着瓦尔肯的重建。
value: Notes left behind by members of the Genison Clan, documenting the reconstruction of WUERKEN.

key: 狗屁不通的……剧本？看得出编剧只想快点结束这一切，或者结束自己。这种东西为什么能保存至今呢？
value: A completely incomprehensible... script? It's obvious the writer just wanted to get everything over with as quickly as possible. Or maybe end themselves. How something like this survived to the present day is beyond comprehension.

key: 康拉德粉丝的又一力作，没有丝毫创作瓶颈。
value: Another masterpiece from one of Konrad's fans. Evidently, creativity was never an issue for them.

key: 来自奥鲁姆人的笔记，记录了瓦尔肯与奥鲁姆友好的过去。
value: Notes left by an Orum citizen, recording the friendly relations WUERKEN and Orum once shared.

key: 一封绝望的书信，死者亲手记录了奥鲁姆对瓦尔肯的背叛。
value: A letter filled with despair, personally written by the deceased to document Orum's betrayal of WUERKEN.

key: 一个夜游鬼的笔记，谁知道夜游鬼还会写日记呢？
value: The diary of a Nightstalker. Who would've thought Nightstalkers kept journals?

key: 来自瓦尔肯老人的日记，字里行间记录着老者对故友的思念。
value: A diary left behind by an elderly Wuerkenian, every line filled with longing for old friends long gone.

key: 一行四人的聊天记录，记录了几位勇敢者的陨落，一起不折不扣的悲剧。
value: A group chat log from four companions, chronicling the deaths of several brave souls. A genuine tragedy from beginning to end.

key: 一位锻工满纸怨气的日记，哪怕看一眼都会力竭。
value: A blacksmith's diary overflowing with resentment. Just reading it feels utterly exhausting.

key: 由潘娜西娅赠予，能稳定特殊的时空残片，并自动记录内部数据。通体由莫氏硬度极高的熔锻晶体制成，结构精巧，似乎可以使用某种方式开启。
打铁装备套组，有锤子、铁钳、冲子、凿子等。上面刻着一行小字，是某个大氏族宗师的专用设备。
value: A blacksmithing equipment set containing hammers, tongs, punches, chisels, and more. A small inscription on it identifies it as the personal gear of a grandmaster from one of the great clans.

key: 曾用于庆祝日的酒杯。过去大多为乌尔芬钢材质，现如今更多以不锈钢替代。大迁徙之后被部分幸存的瓦尔肯人带来恶土。
value: A goblet once used during celebration festivals. Most were originally made from Urfeuerstahl, though stainless steel is more common nowadays. After the Great Migration, some surviving Wuerkenians brought them into the Badlands.

key: 恶土的通用货币之一，作为帮派势力的象征，铜面会印有不同的花纹。
value: One of the standard currencies used across the Badlands. As a symbol of gang affiliation, each copper token bears its own unique engraved pattern.

key: 刻有ZIC标识的制式磁带盒。道具有类似子弹撞击留下的凹坑，其他部分几近完美，只有很小一部分被黑色污染物覆盖，这些污染物腐蚀了该道具，腐蚀的边缘呈现碳化状。
value: A standard cassette case marked with the ZIC logo. The item bears dents resembling bullet impacts, while the rest remains nearly pristine. Only a small section is covered in black contaminants that have corroded the surface, leaving carbonized edges around the damage.

key: 刻有HAVENLY标识的制式磁带盒。外壳表面有严重磨损，有墨绿色的颜色浸染，浸染的区域留下了像是硫酸腐蚀的痕迹。道具的一部分被黑色污染物覆盖，这些污染物腐蚀了该道具，腐蚀的边缘呈现碳化状。
value: A standard cassette case marked with the HAVENLY logo. The casing is heavily worn, stained with a dark green discoloration that resembles sulfuric acid corrosion. Part of the item is covered in black contaminants that have corroded the surface, leaving carbonized edges around the damage.

key: 刻有BLACK HALL标识的制式磁带盒。外壳表面大部分有密集的刀具刻痕和刺痕。道具的一部分被黑色污染物覆盖，这些污染物腐蚀了该道具，腐蚀的边缘呈现碳化状。
value: A standard cassette case marked with the BLACK HALL logo. Most of the casing is covered in dense knife marks and puncture scars. Part of the item is covered in black contaminants that have corroded the surface, leaving carbonized edges around the damage.

key: 装有神秘礼物的礼盒，开启之前，永远猜不透里面藏着怎样的惊喜。使用后可随机获得普通礼物。
value: A gift box containing a mysterious present. Until it's opened, there's no telling what kind of surprise awaits inside. Use it to randomly obtain a Common Gift.

key: 装有神秘礼物的礼盒，开启之前，永远猜不透里面藏着怎样的惊喜。使用后可随机获得精致礼物。
value: A gift box containing a mysterious present. Until it's opened, there's no telling what kind of surprise awaits inside. Use it to randomly obtain a Refined Gift.
