value:
To all non-Devivor personnel: exercise extreme caution when using the protective gear procured from Zelle Complex. The HUD interface is unstable and generates frequent pop-up overlays that severely obstruct vision.
Two employees have already suffered injuries after visual obstruction caused them to step onto Tenebrium spikes, resulting in equipment failure and potential exposure risk. They are currently undergoing full diagnostic evaluation at Ankh Lab.
If Havenly's newer equipment is unavailable, please revert to our older in-house protective models. They may be less comfortable due to heat retention, but they are significantly more stable.

In short, use with caution.

key:
我始终反对在矿洞内建造反应堆，还建在两个营地之间，这种需要日常维护的设备建在营地外是怎么想的？
出问题需要紧急维修怎么办？
在办公室里看着地图一拍脑门就定了位置是吧？
说什么涌晶即采即用，现在倒好，矿洞下面不断有蚀生体涌出来，没御能者带路根本没法靠近。
中转站那边说请了个侵蚀行者过来，结果到现在也没见到人，这活谁爱干谁干吧。

等什么时候反应堆被蚀生体砸了，采掘进度停了，报表账面不好看了，上头的人才会知错。
value:
I've always been against building a reactor inside a mine shaft, especially one placed right between two active camps. Who thought it was a good idea to install equipment that requires constant maintenance outside a controlled facility?
What happens when something breaks and emergency repairs are needed?
Did someone just look at a map in an office and drop a pin without thinking it through?
They keep saying Surgarites can be extracted and used immediately, but now we've got Devourborne crawling up from beneath the mine. Without an Attuner guiding the route, nobody can even get close anymore.
Some staff at the Transfer Hub said a Devour Walker was hired, but no one has seen them yet. At this rate, whoever wants the job can have it.

Maybe when the reactor finally gets smashed by Devourborne, extraction halts, and the reports start looking bad on paper, only then will those at the top admit they messed up.

key:
一条条裂缝将大地与天空撕裂，

污秽的黑水从中涌出，

它们不仅能吞噬活物，就连盔甲和刀剑也不放过……

被黑水吞噬的万物，

最终都会变成嗜血的傀儡。

这个世界最终像泡沫一般崩解，

而抵抗的意志则更早消亡。

黑厄不是我们能够战胜的敌人，

而是我们，

终将奔赴的命运。

我们付出了巨大的牺牲

承受着血肉剥离之苦

越过凡人难以僭越的障壁

窃取了世界之核

务必保管好这重生的火种

一、规范穿戴防护服、防护头盔，不拿生命开玩笑。

二、规范作业时间，单次在侵蚀区内作业时间不得超过八小时，安全生产大于天。

三、作业时不得单独行动，队员之间保持距离，不得离开他人的视野范围。

四、进出侵蚀区时严格检测，不得夹带任何黑质浓度超标物品，勿贪蝇头小利。

五、持证上岗，定期组织侵蚀抗性检测，不合格者立刻停止工作。

侵蚀异象发生时：

牢记三勿——勿惊慌、勿拥挤、勿占用传输节点的通讯频段。

立刻返回采掘基地，排队进入，避免踩踏事故发生。

穿戴防护服，快速进入避难区域躲避，安静等待警报解除。

如发现周围有人陷入“虚梦”，随时观察其眼白颜色，若接近全黑，可通过静脉注射空气等手段帮其终结痛苦。

近期可能会有安卡实验室的工作人员来访，各岗哨注意放行。

小队长各自检查队员仪容仪表，保持干净、整洁的良好面貌。

少听少问，做好手头的工作。

执行董事 贝尔福特

他是指引我们走出泥沼的明灯，
是照亮前行之路的灯塔。
是这座伟大要塞的奠基者，
也是克洛泽氏族的创始人。
是他将数百个氏族召集在一起，
变成了今天的瓦尔肯人。

他的一意孤行！也为我们召来了毁灭！
value:
He was the beacon that led us out of the mire,
the lighthouse that lit our path forward.
The pioneer of this great bastion,
the founder of the Klose Clan.
He was the one who gathered thousands of scattered clans,
and forged them into the Wuerkenians today.

It was also his stubbornness that brought ruin down upon us all!

key:

Faithful Ally — Enstana Zelle

Without her, we would never have stood united.

May the friendship between Orum and WUERKEN endure forever.

She arrives draped in the night itself, moonlight shimmering in her eyes. The rise and fall of the spotlight stretches on like an endless cycle of day and night, until a dazzling dream is frozen into eternity in a single fleeting moment.

key:
核心机制
塔可使用[高速呼叫]、[最终手段！]，可呼叫无人机群投放飞弹，命中敌人赋予其[诱导]效果。
[诱导]效果：每次受击都有概率触发[激光]，造成伤害，持续5秒。

御能者对敌人造成伤害时可获得终结技能量。当终结技能量满值时，可释放威力强大的终结技，终结技释放期间御能者获得无敌。
部分御能者可在空中或受击时释放终结技。

战斗状态下切换御能者时，若离场御能者援护值已满，则消耗其全部援护值，入场御能者释放援护技登场，期间无敌。
此操作可以在当前御能者受击时释放。

御能者可以通过闪避来躲避敌人的攻击，在敌人攻击时闪避可触发完美闪避。
御能者触发完美闪避可获得增益，具体效果取决于御能者自身。

部分御能者的攻击会进行识破判定。
如果敌人正处于动作前摇，则判定成功，御能者获得增益，具体效果取决于御能者自身。

按下跳跃按钮，御能者会向上方跃起并获得短暂无敌状态。
战斗中可释放跳跃来躲避部分攻击。

当敌人存在平衡值时，它的攻击较难被打断。
当敌人的平衡值被清空时，它将陷入一段时间的失衡状态，部分敌人在此状态下无法行动。
value:
When an enemy has Balance Value, its attacks are harder to interrupt.
When its Balance Value is fully depleted, it enters a period of Stagger, during which some enemies are unable to act.

key:
战斗定位为【攻坚】的御能者对拥有平衡值的敌人造成的生命值伤害提高。
在【攻坚】御能者因其他御能者援护技离场时，队伍中非【攻坚】定位御能者会被赋予离场御能者的攻坚效果并持续一段时间。

战斗定位为【强袭】的御能者对平衡值为零的敌人造成的生命值伤害提高。
在【强袭】御能者因其他御能者援护技离场时，队伍中非【强袭】定位御能者会被赋予离场御能者的强袭效果并持续一段时间。

战斗频域为【共振】的御能者在场时，当前御能者或后台御能者攻击命中会为其提供共振值。
共振值达到指定数值后，可触发共振效果，触发方式以及具体效果取决于御能者自身。

战斗频域为【噪波】的御能者可对敌人施加噪波类负面状态，具体效果取决于御能者自身。
部分频域为【噪波】的御能者在攻击命中时，会根据敌人身上存在的噪波类状态数量获得增益。

部分御能者能够对敌人施加【噪波-腐蚀】。
处于【噪波-减防】的敌人，再被施加【噪波-腐蚀】时，【噪波-减防】会被转变为同层数的【噪波-腐蚀】。
【噪波-腐蚀】:使敌人防御力大幅下降，持续期间被施加的【噪波-减防】会转变为【噪波-腐蚀】，至多叠加5层。

部分御能者可将【噪波-迟缓】转变为【噪波-凝滞】。
【噪波-凝滞】：基于敌人抗性短暂冻结敌人，并使其一段时间内受到的伤害提高。

战斗风格为【猛击】的御能者部分攻击会造成碾压伤害。
碾压伤害基于御能者当前最大生命值计算，命中敌人后可回复一定比例的生命值，此伤害不可暴击。

战斗风格为【策应】的御能者部分攻击会造成弱点伤害。
弱点伤害无视目标防御，且不可暴击，此伤害会根据御能者属性中弱点伤害增幅的提升而获得提升。

战斗风格为【奇袭】的御能者部分攻击会造成超限伤害。

战斗风格为【技巧】的御能者可通过达成一定条件进入集中状态。
集中状态下，御能者造成的所有伤害都将得到提升，提升幅度受御能者属性中集中状态增幅的影响。

每位御能者都拥有战斗频域，频域分为【回声】、【噪波】、【共振】三种。

每位御能者都拥有战斗风格，风格分为【闪击】、【策应】、【奇袭】、【猛击】、【技巧】五种。
不同战斗风格的御能者所侧重的养成属性不同。
每位御能者拥有不同的专属技能。技能类型分为：普通攻击、特殊技、终结技、援护技、心相。

key:
“检测结果已然表明，这根藤杖并非人类制造的表演道具——其藤木主体与镶嵌的宝石元素构成完全未知，它来自一个与我们截然不同的时空。据此，我们或许可以推测：宇宙中确实存在一个依赖法杖驱动魔法的文明，其操纵魔法的体质恰似我们人类御能者的黑质抵抗体质。显而易见的是，这把藤杖已遭黑质彻底腐蚀，这是否在某种程度上昭示了该文明的覆灭？我们不得不思考，倘若魔法最终未能挽救他们，那么，哈洛世界中的我们又将面临怎样的结局？”
——实时评论员 鲁希尼亚·克里斯蒂娜 摘自《世纪新知 312期》
value:
"The test results have already confirmed that this vine staff was not a stage prop crafted by human hands. Both the wooden structure and the gem-like inlays are composed of entirely unknown materials. It originated from a spacetime completely unlike our own. From this, we may reasonably speculate that somewhere in the universe, there truly existed a civilization that relied on staffs to wield magic. Their aptitude for manipulating magic appears strikingly similar to humanity's Tenebrium resistance seen in Attuners. What is obvious, however, is that this staff has been completely corrupted by Tenebrium. Could this, in some way, signify the downfall of that civilization? And if even magic ultimately failed to save them... then what fate awaits us in the world of Halo?"
—Live Commentator Luscinia Christina, excerpt from Century New Knowledge, Issue 312

key:
勾爪外形的机动装置，能够与漂浮于空气中的特殊涌晶产生吸引，进行短距离快速移动。
该机动装置设计之初被用于早期侵蚀裂隙探索，随着裂隙探索相关研究的方向性变动，如今被汰换下来，并研制出了民用版本，主要用于紧急规避突发的危机。
value:
A claw-shaped mobility device capable of latching onto special airborne Surgarites, allowing for rapid short-range movement.
The device was originally designed for early exploration of Devouring Rifts. As research priorities shifted over time, it was eventually phased out and replaced with a civilian version primarily intended for emergency evasive maneuvers during sudden crises.

key:
这一次的发现，与以往截然不同。这枚不起眼的玻璃管，或许正指向一个不可思议的猜想——这个时空残片中的生命体，竟在豢养蚀生体，就像我们饲养牲畜一般。我也曾尝试过类似的方向，但无一例外，皆以失败告终。蚀生体不仅带来黑质与威胁，更常常采取自毁式的攻击。在实验室环境下，想让它们配合，根本是痴人说梦。然而眼前这些成组封存的瓶装黑质，更像是被刻意准备的“饲料”，用以引导蚀生体持续为源核补充能量。这样的技术，究竟是如何实现的？实在令人费解……
——萨尔菲 随笔
value:
This discovery was unlike anything we'd encountered before. This unassuming glass tube may point to an astonishing possibility—that the lifeforms within this Spatiotemporal Fragment were actually breeding Devourborne the same way we raise livestock. I once attempted similar research myself, but every experiment ended in failure. Devourborne don't just bring Tenebrium and danger—they also tend to attack with complete disregard for their own survival. Under laboratory conditions, expecting them to cooperate is pure fantasy. And yet, these sealed batches of bottled Tenebrium in front of us look more like deliberately prepared "feed," meant to guide Devourborne into continuously replenishing the Nucleus's energy supply. How exactly was technology like this achieved? The answer completely escapes me...
—From the notes of Salfi

key:
我们从时空残片中收集过许多兼具艺术与审美价值的造物——有的诡谲神秘，有的简约流畅。然而这一件，我得说，其平庸与乏味，几乎到了令人讶异的地步。而偏偏，它又是此一时空残片中唯一可被称为“艺术”的元素。或许，这块铁板与几个圆圈图案，确实承载着某种难以参悟的深意，像是试图揭示某种极简的真理。但我尚无能力确证，姑且存疑，留给后人品评吧。
——艺术评论员 嘉西亚 书
value:
We have recovered many objects from Spatiotemporal Fragments that possessed both artistic and aesthetic value — some unsettling and mysterious, others sleek in their simplicity. But this one... I must admit, its sheer dullness borders on shocking. And yet, somehow, it also happens to be the only thing within this Spatiotemporal Fragment that could truly be called "art." Perhaps this iron plate and its circular patterns really do carry some profound meaning beyond comprehension, an attempt to reveal a kind of minimalist truth. But I lack the insight to prove it. For now, I'll leave the question unanswered and let future generations decide for themselves.
—Written by Art Critic Garcia

key:
“你以为这种零件跟垃圾一样随处可见吗？”他把齿轮举到你眼前，齿牙还在转，而他的瞳孔浑浊不堪，“你以为自己的小命能在它们的锯齿下逃出生天吗？你以为当你的身体被切割成无数遍，你不用为此支付巨额赔偿费吗？这些废弃零件的价值——可比你的小命高多了！”
“它们是武器，你只是耗材。”
——当事件被如此转述，真实的不再是所发生的一切，而是残留于此的物品本身。经过加工的话语会成为故事，而被加工的零件会成为武器。
value:
"You think parts like this are just lying around like trash?" He held the gear right up to your face. The teeth were still turning, while his own eyes looked cloudy and worn. "You think your pathetic little life could survive getting caught in those blades? You think when your body gets shredded over and over again, you won't be stuck paying a fortune in compensation fees? These scrap parts are worth way more than your life ever was!"
"They're the weapons. And you're just some expendable material."
Once a story is retold this way, what matters is no longer what truly happened, but the object left behind. Words shaped and polished become stories. Parts reshaped and reforged become weapons.

key:
你从废料堆里扒出那块煤的时候，它正在变色。它只有一个拳头的大小，黑漆漆的，跟旁边成千上万块煤没什么两样。可当你手中的矿灯打上一束光，它的表面就泛起一层极淡的蓝紫。
不是表面那层浮光，是整个石头都在发光，你这才看清，那根本不是煤，至少不是你以为的那种煤。
“那是什么？”你打开手电筒，让更透亮的光束落在煤块上。
“这是电池，活的电池。”你的领队淡淡地回答，像是在叙说会呼吸的石头。她告诉你，电取代了火，正如同御能者取代了他们。
“拾起来吧，路上还要用。”
value:
When you dug that chunk of coal out of the scrap pile, it was changing color. About the size of a fist, pitch black, no different from the thousands of other lumps scattered nearby. But the moment your mining lamp hit it, a faint blue-violet glow shimmered across its surface.
Not just the surface — the whole stone was glowing. That was when you realized it wasn't coal at all. At least, not the kind of coal you thought it was.
"What is that?" you asked, switching on your flashlight and letting a brighter beam fall over the coal.
"That's a battery. A living battery." Your squad leader answered calmly, as if she were talking about a rock that could breathe. She told you electricity had replaced fire, just as Attuners had replaced people like them.
"Pick it up. We'll need it on the road."

key:
由攀附手套与攀附鞋组成的装备套组，启用后能够吸附在特定的墙面上，并进行位置固定与垂直移动。
该装备套组通过放大失活涌晶微弱的吸引力以起到吸附效果，但对操作的需求很高，普通人很难掌握其使用要领，也是因此，该装备套组未能得到大规模生产便被早早放弃，如今已从市面上消失。
value:
A gear set consisting of Adhesion Gloves and Adhesion Boots. Once activated, the equipment can latch onto designated wall surfaces, allowing the user to anchor themselves in place and move vertically.
The set works by amplifying the faint attraction generated by inert Surgarites to create its adhesion effect. However, operating it requires an extremely high level of skill, making it difficult for ordinary people to use effectively. As a result, the equipment was abandoned long before entering mass production and has since vanished from the market.

value:
[Special Mobile Unit – Orum Bastion – Extraction Site No. 1 – Regional Combat Report]
...
During the investigation of Extraction Site No. 1, the Special Mobile Unit came under a bombing attack carried out by an unidentified drone.
Following a pursuit operation, the squad successfully intercepted the drone inside a cave.
After inspection by Rita, the drone was identified as a commercially available M2 model. However, its data storage medium had been encrypted, and a self-destruct sequence activated after interception. As a result, the drone's origin could not be traced at this stage. Further intelligence would be required to continue the investigation.

N802-06研究员：据萨尔菲博士说，亥伯龙的钻机部分是由泽尔联合负责制造的，强度可能胜过目前我们已知的所有金属以及合金。为了验证这一点，我尝试将它安装在碎石机上进行测试，在进行到与金刚石表面碰撞时，钻头侧端出现了损伤。看来泽尔联合也不过如此嘛，也许它们应该在强度上再多下些功夫。
M406-01管理员：……接下来三个月，N802研究组的研究资金归零。当然，前提是你能在萨尔菲博士的怒火下存活。
value:
Researcher N802-06: According to Dr. Salfi, the drill section of the Hebron was manufactured by Zelle Complex, and its durability may surpass every metal and alloy currently known to us. To verify that claim, I mounted it onto an industrial crusher for testing. During impact testing against a diamond surface, damage appeared along the side edge of the drill bit. Looks like Zelle Complex isn't all that impressive after all. Maybe they should've spent a little more effort on durability.
Administrator M406-01: ...The N802 research group's funding will be reduced to zero for the next three months. Assuming, of course, that you survive Dr. Salfi's wrath.

key:
SL-03-0190 研究报告
研究对象：鞘甲骸激光发射器
研究目的：分析鞘甲骸激光发射器的设计原理与制造技术，旨在揭示其高功率输出、精准控制及环境适应性的实现路径，为御能武器的研发和制造提供新方向。
……
研究进程：因其基础设计原型缺失，且核心部件已损毁，当前研究工作陷入停滞，需要更多数据才可继续推进。有趣的是，我们在研究过程中发现该激光发射装置对某种甜品有特殊反应，具体原因尚不明晰，相关实验人员需要注意，进入实验室时请勿携带食物。
value:
SL-03-0190 Research Report
Research Subject: Sheathbeetle Husk Laser Emitter
Research Objective: To analyze the design principles and manufacturing technology behind the Sheathbeetle Husk Laser Emitter, with the goal of uncovering the mechanisms responsible for its high-output performance, precision control, and environmental adaptability. Findings may provide new directions for the development and production of Attuner Weapons.
...
Research Progress: Due to the absence of the original design prototype and the destruction of core components, current research efforts have stalled. Additional data will be required before the project can continue. Interestingly, researchers discovered that the laser emitter reacts abnormally to a certain type of dessert. The exact cause remains unclear. Personnel are reminded not to bring food into the laboratory during ongoing experiments.

偶尔能从精锐蜥蜴型蚀生体残骸上获得的战利品，保存完好，可用于技能升级。

残破的核心布满了裂痕，守护要塞的精锐机器人永无停息地战斗，直到他们的生命终于无法负荷……

只有较低的概率能从精英智械体内获取的完整核心，可用于技能升级。
承载着前人智慧的神奇核心，如果能够解析重组，或许就能创造出不亚于智械的全新智能机械。

罕见的超频核心，在使用中能够发挥超过寻常智械的算力，可用于技能升级。
智械们在失控后再无法得到相应的保养和维护，它们超负荷运转的核心无法停歇，只能不停地推动自身的疯狂。

自蚀生体“孤独的·护火骑士”身上掉落的魔爪零件。可用于装备打造。

自蚀生体“孤独的·护火骑士”身上掉落的某种鸟喙碎片。可用于装备打造。
通身被硬质物体包裹，边角尤为锋利，拾起要多加小心，也许存在致命危险。

自“受蚀者·异变体”身上掉落的鳞甲。可用于装备打造。
拥有鲜艳的色泽以及坚实的硬度。鳞片的纹路似乎也在证明这不是一只普通的生物。

自“受蚀者·异变体”身上掉落的前牙。可用于装备打造。
高饱和的色泽淬满毒液，比起龙牙更像是一种暗器，能够想象它出自多么奇异的生物。

自“暴走的·亥伯龙”身上掉落的核心装置。可用于装备打造。

自“暴走的·亥伯龙”身上掉落的前进装置。可用于装备打造。
这是一根损坏的履带，长期磨损的条件下，仍旧工整的边角说明其高度机械化的工业水平。

自“蚀尘的·鞘骸”身上掉落的蚀化显示器，可用于装备打造。
被鞘骸侵蚀并吸收后成为了它身体上的一部分，可惜它的屏幕上再也不会显示任何内容。

自“蚀尘的·鞘骸”身上掉落的能量结晶，可用于装备打造。
被鞘骸侵蚀并吸收后成为了它身体上的一部分，只是在这不见天日的工厂中，原本最重要的发电功能却不再起效。

自“暴动者·瓦棱特”身上掉落的零件。可用于装备打造。
螺丝的强度是哈洛星球暂时无法比拟的，或许可以作为研究的好素材。

自“暴动者·瓦棱特”身上掉落的涌晶电池。可用于装备打造。

从亥伯龙型工程机甲上拆除的黑色齿轮，可用于装备打造。
警告！警告！请勿靠近！请勿靠近！

key:
克洛托典藏系列时装。
她身披夜色而来，眸中盈着满月清辉，聚光灯的明灭如昼夜交替般漫长，绮丽的梦境在瞬间定格成永恒。
盈盈一笑间，指尖流光轻转，她向你伸出手，嗓音如珍珠滑过丝缎——“尊贵的客人，愿意与我共舞一曲吗？”
value:
Clotho archive collection outfit.
She arrives draped in the night itself, moonlight shimmering in her eyes. The rise and fall of the spotlight stretches on like an endless cycle of day and night, until a dazzling dream is frozen into eternity in a single fleeting moment.
With a gentle smile, light dances across her fingertips as she extends a hand toward you, her voice smooth as pearls gliding across silk. "Distinguished guest... would you care to share a dance with me?"

从大型蚀生体上获得的硬化角质，可用来开启部分原本无法通行的道路。
锋利的角质具备强大的切割能力，若非质地坚硬到无法进行加工，它完全可以用作上等御能者武器的材料。

从“亥伯龙”型机械上获得的机械臂，可用来开启部分原本无法通行的道路。
御能者的力量固然强大，但面对顽固的乱石堆，还得靠工业机械——它们可不是一般的障碍物，必须要出重拳！

何雨莲精心收藏的纸质错版书籍，保存良好，鲜有折痕，散发着淡雅的香气。
在许多页的空白处，还有手写的注解，字迹工整娟秀。
从种种迹象都可以看出，前主人一定十分爱惜这本书。
value:
A carefully preserved misprinted paper book from LIAN's personal collection. Well maintained, scarcely creased, and carrying a faint, elegant scent.
Handwritten annotations fill many of the margins, the script neat and graceful.
Everything about it makes one thing clear: its previous owner treasured this book deeply.

key:
由艾提亲手所做的肉丸，尽管制作过程被她描述得十分恐怖，但味道却还不错。
在这个时代，肉类是十分珍贵的食材，所以也算是价值不菲的礼物。

价格并不亲民的碳酸饮料，虽有着其他饮料比不上的劲爽口感，但普通人于日常生活中绝不会考虑购买。
当今世界已几乎没有了种植水果的条件，果味饮品一度在市面上绝迹，开口开乐则是市面上为数不多带有水果风味的饮料——据说开口开乐公司将其中的秘方存放在了某个隐秘的保险库中，全世界只有不超过四个人知晓其所在地。
value:
An outrageously overpriced soda. Its crisp, punchy kick is unmatched by any ordinary drink, but for the average person, buying it for everyday consumption isn't even a consideration.
In today's world, the conditions needed to grow fruit have all but disappeared, and fruit-flavored drinks nearly vanished from the market. OpenJoy Cola is one of the few surviving beverages with an actual fruit profile. Rumor has it the company keeps its secret formula locked away in a hidden vault, and fewer than four people in the world know where it is.

key:
价格昂贵的手工白巧克力饼干，黑质含量为零，食用时与其担心黑质淤积，不如担心糖分摄入引起的脂肪淤积。
据说这款产品名称的灵感来自于——打住！“匠心手作”、“纯天然无添加”、“名字来源有着一段浪漫的故事”……如此种种，还请千万不要相信！这不过是为了卖出高价的商业手段！
value:
A premium handmade white chocolate cookie with no Tenebrium. Honestly, instead of worrying about Tenebrium buildup, you should probably be more concerned about what the sugar's doing to your waistline.
Rumor says the product's name was inspired by—actually, stop right there! "Artisan-crafted," "all-natural," "no additives," "a romantic story behind the name"...Don't buy into any of it. It's just marketing dressed up to justify the price tag.

key:
给人以帅气感觉的墨镜，镜架所用的材料据说与御能者武器所使用的一致，轻便且坚固。
这种款式的眼镜不知何时成为了火爆的时尚单品，一些好事者曾对此进行了探究，发现这可能和奥鲁姆民众私下盛行的假面舞会有所关联，这种款式的眼镜似乎就是加入释放压抑情绪舞会的入场券。不过，即便抛开这种莫名其妙的原因，这款眼镜本身的造型也足够吸引人了。
value:
A pair of stylish sunglasses with undeniable cool factor. The frame is reportedly made from the same material used in Attuner Weapons, lightweight, durable, and built to last.
At some point, this style exploded into a full-blown fashion trend. Curious investigators dug into the phenomenon and traced it back to the underground masquerade parties popular among Orum's citizens. Apparently, glasses like these double as your ticket into those emotion-unloading dance nights. That said... even without the bizarre backstory, these shades look good enough to sell themselves.

key:
以黑质为设计灵感的高级腕表，内有微量涌晶，会稳定进行有规律振动，时钟基于该特性而拥有极高的精度。
“付出了多少心跳，换取了一堆发票，人生要减少几秒，值得多买一只表？”“13秒，我是资本主义者。”
value:
A luxury wristwatch inspired by Tenebrium. It contains trace amounts of Surgarites that generate a stable, rhythmic vibration, giving the watch exceptional precision.
"How many heartbeats did you trade for a stack of receipts? If life's getting shorter by the second, is another watch really worth it?" "Thirteen seconds. I'm a capitalist."

key:
用料高级的仿生玩偶，在玩具市场十分火爆，制造商因此推出了不少限定款产品。
这种仿生玩偶类产品具有发声、行走等仿生功能，且不具有仿生动物类产品为强调真实性而不可避免会设计的原生动物所具备的陋习，因而也在宠物市场占据一席之地。
value:
A high-end biomimetic plush made with premium materials. Hugely popular in the toy market, with manufacturers continuously releasing limited-edition versions.
These biomimetic toys can speak, walk, and mimic lifelike behaviors — without inheriting the less charming habits of real animals that "authentic" bio-pets insist on replicating. That's exactly how they carved out a place for themselves in the pet market, too.

key:
气味清新、留香时间较长的香水，在年轻女性群体中十分受欢迎。
该款香水除了增添您的个人魅力，还可有效阻隔各种有害物质的附着，尤其适合需要在侵蚀区行动的御能者们使用，建议御能者常备！[侵蚀管理局提示您，该消息内容可能含有不实内容，请谨慎甄别真实性]
value:
A fresh, clean-scented perfume with impressive staying power, especially popular among younger women.
Besides enhancing your personal charm, this perfume also effectively blocks harmful contaminants from clinging to the body, making it especially suitable for Attuners operating inside Devouring Areas. Highly recommended as an everyday carry item for all Attuners![Advisory from the E.Z.C: The claims in this message may contain inaccurate or misleading information. Please exercise caution when evaluating their authenticity.]

key:
十分出圈的掌上游戏机，在历经数年后终于推出了新款，一经推出便成为热销商品。
尽管新款游戏机的机能依旧落后于同时代的其他产品，且不断涨价的限定游戏卡带也惹得游戏玩家们怨声载道，但这不妨碍玩家们购买它，并发自真心地呼喊：“人天大就是这个世界的主宰！”
value:
A wildly popular handheld game console that finally launched its long-awaited new model after years of anticipation, and it instantly became a bestseller.
Sure, the new hardware still lags behind competing systems of its era, and the ever-rising price of limited-edition game cartridges has players complaining nonstop. But none of that stops fans from buying it and proudly shouting from the heart: "Nintendai rules the world!"

key:
高端消费级显卡，除了具备强劲的游戏性能外，还能胜任高强度的计算工作。
在这款显卡推出之前，人们一度认为它的大小会直逼空调外机，一些厂家也听信了这种流言，为此绞尽脑汁，甚至考虑过以千斤顶为原型设计显卡支架。
value:
A high-end consumer graphics card built not only for top-tier gaming performance, but also capable of handling heavy computational workloads
Before this graphics card launched, people genuinely believed it would be about the size of an outdoor AC unit. Some manufacturers even bought into the rumor, racking their brains over support-bracket designs — one of them reportedly considered using a car jack as inspiration.

key:
文字晦涩、遣词前卫的长篇小说典藏版，只有小众文艺才有耐心阅读。
书页与书皮都十分讲究，完全由如今十分昂贵的纸张组成，能够为您带来电子屏无法替代的触觉体验，虽然小说中诗意的文字在您看来或许不过是叽里咕噜的鸟语，但从另一方面来说，至少它还能在您阅读小说并忍不住犯困时用来充当枕头。
value:
A collector's edition of an avant-garde novel packed with dense prose and aggressively experimental wording. Only the most dedicated literary niche readers have the patience for it.
The pages and cover are crafted with painstaking attention to detail, made entirely from very expensive paper. It offers a tactile experience no screen can replicate. Granted, the novel's poetic language may sound like incomprehensible bird noises to you, but on the bright side, it can at least double as a pillow when the reading inevitably makes you sleepy.

key:
为纪念某前卫专辑发行225周年的典藏版黑胶唱片，在摇滚爱好者圈子中颇为抢手。
实际上，这种黑胶唱片只是外形为黑胶唱片的音乐存储盘，制造商还特意将歌曲存储数量减少至单盘14首，以增加其“黑胶风味”而对于这种倒行逆施的行为，音乐爱好者们的评价自然是——拍手叫好。
value:
A collector's edition vinyl record commemorating the 225th anniversary of a groundbreaking album release. A hot commodity among rock fans.
Technically, this "vinyl" is just a music storage disc shaped like a vinyl record. The manufacturer even deliberately reduced the track count to 14 songs per disc to enhance the "authentic vinyl vibe." And naturally, music enthusiasts responded to this gloriously backwards decision with overwhelming approval.

key:
能够提升愈合药剂剂效的稳定液，只可用于部分特定的愈合注射器。
可在注入疗愈注射器后，于注射管内壁形成涂层，与愈合药剂接触后可提高药剂的剂效。
value:
A stabilizing agent that enhances the effectiveness of healing compounds. Compatible only with certain specialized healing injectors.
When injected into a recovery injector, it forms a coating along the inner wall of the injector chamber that amplifies the healing compound's effectiveness upon contact.

key:
使用后能够提升愈合药剂剂效的稳定液，只能作用于【余力注射器·制式Ⅰ型】。
可在注入疗愈注射器后，于注射管内壁形成涂层，与愈合药剂接触后可提高药剂的剂效。该涂层只能附着于特定材质的管壁上，且研究者并不计划解决此情况。

侵蚀管理局于特殊行动中发放的疗愈注射器，是以现有注射器为模板研发的军用制式改进版本，具有在特定情况下强化进攻能力的附加剂效。
该款注射器由私人研究者勒梅·弗拉梅尔提供，侵蚀管理局将此进行了制式化改造。原本计划大规模采购，但沃登博士以“该研究者的研制品有极大安全风险”为由进行回绝，规模化生产计划因此被搁置。研究者勒梅对此的回应，只有毫不在意的大笑。
value:
A recovery injector distributed by the E.Z.C for special operations. Developed from existing injector models, this military-standard upgraded version includes an additive effect that enhances offensive capability under specific conditions.
This injector was originally developed by the independent researcher Lemaire Flamel, then standardized and adapted by the E.Z.C. A large-scale procurement plan was initially proposed, but Dr. Warden rejected it, citing "serious safety concerns surrounding the researcher's designs." As a result, mass production was shelved, and Lemaire's response to the decision was nothing but a loud, utterly unconcerned laugh.

key:
由韦伯通讯建设的监测塔，能够发送和接收特殊的长波频段，能够最大程度避免因侵蚀区而产生的信号丢失，满足御能者在侵蚀区内的通讯需求。
虽然基站在设计上配备了多种侵蚀防护手段，但面对侵蚀区瞬息万变的恶劣环境，还是会频繁离线。离线的基站往往经过简单维护就能恢复正常运转。
value:
A signal relay base constructed by Weber Communications, capable of transmitting and receiving specialized longwave frequencies, minimizing signal loss caused by Devouring Areas and ensuring communication support for Attuners within affected areas.
Although equipped with multiple Devour-resistant systems, the rapidly changing hostile environment often forces it offline. With simple maintenance, it can usually be restored.

key:
那只强大的蚀生体出现了，你和你的队友必须直面强大的怪物。
现在的选项只剩一个，那就是放手一搏。

我们在黑厅查看证据后得知，想要追回“时空奇点”，必须先从调查契尔斯通的走私渠道开始。
因契尔斯通董事贝尔福特的激烈反对，罗西娅议员称需议会表决才能让我们对契尔斯通进一步调查，但我们显然没有那么多时间。何雨莲显然也没有放弃，而是用餐券作为暗号，约我们在一处叫做“蟹屋”的餐厅见面，继续商议该如何追回“时空奇点”。
value:
After reviewing the evidence at Black Hall, we learn that if we want to recover the "Spatiotemporal Singularity," we'll first have to investigate Keystone's smuggling network.
Because of fierce opposition from Keystone board member Belfort, Councilor Róisín insists that any further investigation into Keystone must go through a council vote, but we clearly don't have that kind of time. LIAN hasn't given up either. Using a meal coupon as a coded signal, she arranges to meet us at a restaurant called the "Crab House" to continue discussing how to retrieve the "Spatiotemporal Singularity."

key:
因与泽尔联合跟契尔斯通存在旧怨，海文利集团的薇诺娜决定帮助我们，她给了我们一张不限额的黑卡，同时让终于自己的下属带我们前往契尔斯通的走私窗口，令我们能够伪装成客户，与走私负责人完成接头。
现在我需要找到那名薇诺娜的下属，获知下一步行动的安排。
value:
Because of old conflicts between the Zelle Complex and Keystone, Vinona of the Havenly Group decided to help us. She provided us with an unlimited black card and arranged for one of her subordinates to take us to Keystone's smuggling entry point, allowing us to pose as clients and make contact with the smuggling handler.
I now need to find that subordinate and confirm the next step of the operation.

在向中转站的守卫表明来意后，我们顺利进入了忘却峡中转站，并且与走私负责人古恩（也是中转站的副站长）完成了洽谈。
从洽谈中我与何雨莲套取到关键信息——契尔斯通竟然堂而皇之地将走私数据储存在中转站的机房内……
另一边，为引走守卫而假装肚子疼的何雨莲似乎也有所发现……
value:
After explaining our purpose to the station guards, we successfully entered the Forgotten Gorge Transfer Hub and met with the smuggling handler, Gunn (also the hub's Deputy Station Chief), to negotiate.
During the discussion, I managed to extract key information with LIAN—Keystone is openly storing smuggling data inside the station's server room...
Meanwhile, LIAN, who pretended to have a stomachache to lure away the guards, seems to have discovered something on her end as well...

塔可每拥有<color=#ffb932>{param1:#0}</color>点基础生命值，弱点伤害提升<color=#ffb932><calculate>{param2:#0.000}</calculate:#0%></color>，至多可提升<color=#ffb932><calculate>{param3:#0.000}</calculate:#0%></color>。
艾提援护登场攻击，造成奇袭伤害，命中时获得<color=#ffb932>100</color>点适能，释放期间无敌。
在艾提因其他角色援护技离场，其他<color=#C5FF60>[共振]</color>角色登场时，艾提获得<color=#ffb932>150</color>适能。
value: When Ethey leaves due to another character's Support Skill and another <color=#C5FF60>Resonance</color> character enters, Ethey gains <color=#FFB932>150</color> Devivor Energy.

key: 玛塔的反击技<color=#C5FF60>[千锻]</color>伤害提升<color=#ffb932><calculate>{param1:#0.000}</calculate:#0%></color>。
莉特莉丝<color=#C5FF60>[洞悉]</color>持续时间变为无限，释放特殊技<color=#C5FF60>[表象之下]</color>命中敌人时，使敌人防御力降低<color=#ffb932><calculate>-1 * {param1:#0.000}</calculate:#0%></color>，持续<color=#ffb932>{param2:#0}</color>秒。

何雨莲消耗全部终结技能量从天而降进行攻击，造成大范围伤害，获得400适能，进入[红莲状态]，并在周围留下2柄[红莲短剑]，冷却时间15秒。
释放该技能期间切换御能者，何雨莲仍会留在场上，发挥[协同]作用。
何雨莲释放特殊技<color=#C5FF60>[瞬影]</color>、<color=#C5FF60>[蔽日]</color>时，获得攻击力提升<color=#ffb932><calculate>{param1:#0.000}</calculate:#0%></color>的效果，持续<color=#ffb932>3</color>秒。
何雨莲释放特殊技<color=#C5FF60>[瞬影]</color>、<color=#C5FF60>[蔽日]</color>命中敌人时，为敌人施加防御力降低<color=#ffb932><calculate>-1 * {param1:#0.000}</calculate:#0%></color>的效果，持续<color=#ffb932>{param2:#0}</color>秒。
何雨莲的特殊技<color=#C5FF60>[瞬影]</color>、<color=#C5FF60>[蔽日]</color>伤害提升<color=#ffb932><calculate>{param1:#0.000}</calculate:#0%></color>，释放期间霸体。
作为特别机动队的队长，你正在为侵蚀管理局执行一项目标为“捕获时空奇点”的任务。由于时序重构仪发生故障，你与队员洛夕在进入时空残片未能抵达预定的坐标位置，并且与另一名队员“莉塔”失散。你的首要目标是冷静下来，并寻找失散的队员。
value: As the captain of the Special Mobile Unit, you had been carrying out a mission for the E.Z.C to capture the Spatiotemporal Singularity. After a malfunction in the Temporal Reconstructor, you and your teammate ROCHE failed to arrive at the designated coordinates upon entering the Spatiotemporal Fragment and became separated from another squad member, Rita. Your top priority was to stay calm and locate your missing teammate.

key: 补交费用后，负责人用另外一个借口让他补交更多的费用。
value: After paying the extra fee, the organizer came up with yet another excuse to demand even more money.

key: 我同洛夕相处了一段时间。我能感觉到我们间的关系到了一个新的阶段。
value: After spending some time with ROCHE, I could feel that the relationship between us had entered a new stage.

key: 我同洛夕相处了一段时间。我能感觉到我们间的关系到了一个新的阶段。
value: After spending some time with ROCHE, I could feel that the relationship between us had entered a new stage.

key: 因侵蚀而产生逻辑链路紊乱的镇爆型机器人。这种携带矢量步枪的机器人精确致命、虚无单发。人们都很喜欢这样充满效率的好家伙，直到这份效率被应用在他们身上。
value: A riot-control robot whose logic circuits were disrupted by Devour. Armed with a vector rifle, it delivers precise and lethal shots with ruthless efficiency. People always loved machines this efficient, right up until that efficiency was turned against them.

key: 不知名的世界被原态侵蚀毁灭后，曾经生活于其中的生物遗留在侵蚀中的倒影。它们没有思想和智慧，只剩世界毁灭时的意志化作的强大攻击性，驱使它们永无止境地相互残杀。
value: After an unknown world was destroyed by Primordial Devour, what remained were echoes of the beings that once lived there, left behind within the Devour itself. They possess no thought or intelligence, only a fierce, unending aggression formed from the will of that world's final collapse, driving them to slaughter one another without end.

key: 因侵蚀而产生逻辑链路紊乱的人形机器人。最初以保护人员为方针设计的机器人，如今它手上的利刃化为了那些当初被保护者最恐惧的阴影。
value: A humanoid robot whose logic circuits were disrupted by Devour. Originally designed with the protection of personnel in mind, the robot's blades have now become the very shadow feared by those it was meant to protect.

key: 受到侵蚀影响而逻辑链路出现故障的作业型机器人。手中的链锯原本是为人们切开障碍开辟生路的工具，谁能想到它还能切开人们的身体呢？
value: A labor robot whose logic circuits malfunctioned under the effects of Devour. The chainsaw it carries was originally meant to clear obstacles and carve out paths to safety. Who would've thought it could carve through people just as easily?

key: 受到侵蚀影响而逻辑链路出现故障的镇爆型机器人。以前他们是用来那些对付那些对公司制度不满的员工，现在倒好了，所有人都要挨它的铁棍子了。
value: A riot-control robot whose logic circuits malfunctioned under the effects of Devour. It used to be deployed against employees dissatisfied with company policy, and now everyone gets a turn under its steel baton.

key: 受到侵蚀影响而逻辑链路出现故障的镇爆型机器人。会分离出自己一部分动力源进行爆裂性攻击。
value: A riot-control robot whose logic circuits malfunctioned under the effects of Devour. It can detach part of its own power core and launch it as an explosive attack.

key: 受到侵蚀影响而逻辑链路出现故障的安保型机器人。专门用于护卫要员，掌握多种武术与格斗技巧的高端产品，是公司客户们的第一首选。现在公司的售后热线应该要被打爆了。
value: A security robot whose logic circuits malfunctioned under the effects of Devour. Designed specifically to protect high-value personnel, this premium model was equipped with advanced martial arts and close-combat techniques, making it the top choice among corporate clients. The company's customer support lines are probably overwhelmed by now.

key:
由视讯器与蜘蛛组合而成的异合型蚀生体。较为罕见的蚀生体类型，通常出没于被侵蚀吞没的人类居住区中。传闻显像蛛骸会放映出受害者最为恐惧的视讯画面，让这些受害者一步步落入危险的圈套之中并猎杀他们……
【备注：传闻是假的，但可以用过近距离收发信号的方式影响其播放的内容，但一般来说都是呈雪花状的紊乱信号。】
value:
A hybrid Devourborne formed from a video display unit and a spider. A relatively rare type of Devourborne commonly found in human settlements consumed by Devour. Rumor has it these Screenspider Husks project terrifying visions tailored to their victims' deepest fears, luring them step by step into deadly traps before hunting them down...
[Note: The rumor is false, but its playback content can be influenced via close-range signal transmission. However, the result is usually a snow-like pattern of scrambled interference.]

key: 以收讯器与大型兽类组合而成的异合型蚀生体。它的巨大身躯以常人理解的灵敏对敌人发动势大力沉的攻击。一般来说，就算有侵蚀能的加持，生物体与机械体也很难进行如此恰当的耦合，而我只能从那些深入骨髓的机械芯片与肢体边缘的缝合线上，窥视过往真相的一鳞半爪……
value: A hybrid Devourborne created from a receiver fused with a massive beast. Despite its enormous body, it attacks with shocking speed and crushing force far beyond normal understanding. Even enhanced by Devour Energy, biological and mechanical lifeforms should not be able to integrate this perfectly. Yet from the mechanical chips embedded deep in the bone and the sutured seams along the edges of the body, one can glimpse fragments of a terrible truth from the past...

key: 以收讯器与大型兽类组合而成的异合型蚀生体。它的巨大身躯以常人理解的灵敏对敌人发动势大力沉的攻击。一般来说，就算有侵蚀能的加持，生物体与机械体也很难进行如此恰当的耦合，而我只能从那些深入骨髓的机械芯片与肢体边缘的缝合线上，窥视过往真相的一鳞半爪……

key: 以聚能器与大型鸟类组合而成的异合型蚀生体。他们会使用强有力的下肢对敌人发动踢击或根据聚能器的种类发射不同的能量束。就算在侵蚀能的浸染下，大型生物体与机械体也很难进行如此恰当的耦合，而我只能从那些深入骨髓的机械芯片与肢体边缘的缝合线上，窥视过往真相的一鳞半爪……
value: An hybrid Devourborne created from an energy amplifier fused with a giant bird. They attack enemies with powerful kicks from their reinforced legs or fire different energy beams depending on the type of amplifier attached. Even under the influence of Devour Energy, large biological and mechanical lifeforms should not be able to integrate this perfectly. Yet from the mechanical chips embedded deep in the bone and the sutured seams along the edges of the body, one can glimpse fragments of a terrible truth from the past...

key: 在原态侵蚀的黄昏中独自游荡的孤独骑士。虽然只是不知何年代流落到侵蚀中的一道遗影，但从无数彷徨遗影中拼杀而出的他，拥有令人仰望的实力和战斗意志，甚至时刻保持着最适合战斗的姿态。即使是那些强大的使徒也不愿轻撄其锋。如此超群之人，在其生活的年代绝不会是籍籍无名之辈。
value: A lone knight wandering through the twilight of Primordial Devour. Though merely a lingering shadow cast into the Devour from some forgotten era, he carved his way through countless lost echoes and emerged with overwhelming strength and unshakable battle instinct. Even now, he maintains a stance perfectly suited for combat at all times. Even the mighty apostles avoid crossing blades with him lightly. A warrior of such caliber could never have been a nobody in his own age.

key: 穿着重型装备的公司武装干员，由于神经高度与机械链路对接，所以在侵蚀的影响下变得神志不清，攻击任何胆敢靠近的敌人。公司为贵宾客户定制的高规格商品。你说这是人口贩卖？不，我们管这叫"终身雇佣"。
value: A heavily armored corporate operative. Due to the direct integration between its nervous system and mechanical linkages, Devour has driven it into a state of madness, causing it to attack anything that approaches. A premium product custom-made for elite corporate clients. Human trafficking, you say? No, we prefer to call it "lifetime employment."

key: 巨蟒与音波聚能器异合而成的蚀生体，两者在侵蚀能的影响下聚合在一起，同时还能看到一些人工缝合的痕迹。输出蛇骸能使用位于头部音频集群阵发射多类侵蚀辐射，需要谨慎回避，同时也能凭借夸张的弹跳力对敌人进行撞击。从飞溅到它身上的血迹判断，当年那些致力于实现偏执且疯狂的科学狂人付出了同等的代价，真是令人唏嘘……
value: A Devourborne fused from a giant python and a sonic energy amplifier. Under the influence of Devour Energy, the two merged together, with clear signs of crude surgical stitching still visible. The Serpent Husk can unleash multiple forms of Devour radiation through the acoustic arrays in its head, requiring extreme caution when engaging it. It can also slam into enemies with terrifying leaps. Judging from the bloodstains splattered across its body, the mad scientists who pursued their twisted obsession likely paid the same brutal price themselves. A grim thought...

key: 大型兽类与信息调频器异合而成的蚀生体，两者在侵蚀能的影响下聚合在一起，同时还能看到一些人工缝合的痕迹。调频兽骸通常来说不会主动的攻击敌人，但他可以通过发射某种信号来召唤各类异合蚀骸协战。这到底是侵蚀的毁灭意志所引导的变异，亦或者是其最初诞生的目的，具体缘由以被冰雪所掩埋，无人可知。
value: A Devourborne fused from a large beast and an information frequency modulator. Under the influence of Devour Energy, the two merged together, with clear signs of crude surgical stitching still visible. Frequency Beasthusks rarely take the initiative to attack, but they can broadcast signals that summon various Devoured Remains to fight alongside them. Whether this mutation was guided by the destructive will of Devour, or was the creature's original intended purpose, has long since been buried beneath ice and snow.

key: 位于研究设施深处的战争机械，因侵蚀的影响而不受控制地自发启动，任何胆敢靠近者都会被它的炮火所歼灭。汇聚了公司心血与某种不切实际的野心铸造的怪物，希望其能成为公司开创某个时代的象征，被冠以"亚当"之名。但一切不过是幼稚且贪婪的幻想，就和这台"亚当"一样，缺乏"根基"。
value: A war machine buried deep within a research facility, now uncontrollably activated by Devour. Any who approach are obliterated by its overwhelming firepower. A monster forged from the company's obsession and an impossible ambition, intended to symbolize the dawn of a new era. They named it "Adam." But in the end, it was nothing more than a childish and greedy fantasy. Just like this machine itself, it lacked a true "foundation."

key:
生物聚落中霸主级的存在，受到侵蚀能感染后化为可怖的骇兽。身形伟岸且具备强大的破坏力，极具领土意识，性格暴戾，会对攻击一切入侵者。观测到曾有对同类施暴并使其顺服的习性，似乎保留了一定的社会性。

value:
An apex predator within its ecosystem, transformed into a terrifying beast after being infected by Devour Energy. Massive in size and immensely destructive, it possesses an extreme territorial instinct and violently attacks all intruders. Observations suggest it retains traces of social behavior, including violently dominating others of its kind into submission.
[Note: It dislikes the smell of bird droppings. Smearing some on yourself may help avoid its horrifying attacks.]

key: 巨型鞘甲虫与射电脉冲器异合而成的蚀生体，蛰伏于深处禁止任何人接触尘封的禁忌。该蚀生体头部为军用射电脉冲器，用于为洲际战略武器精确制导，如今只为警戒周遭，侵攻一切胆敢窥探丑陋秘辛之人。
value: A Devourborne formed from the fusion of a giant sheathbeetle and a radio pulse transmitter. It lurks deep underground, forbidding anyone from approaching the forbidden secrets buried there. The creature's head is a military-grade radio pulse transmitter once used to guide intercontinental strategic weapons with pinpoint accuracy. Now, it serves only one purpose: to stand watch and annihilate anyone reckless enough to uncover the ugly truth.

key: 因侵蚀污染而暴走的机械体，能以暴风骤雨般的火力摧毁敌人。瓦棱特精明能干，对工作保持高度专注的同时抱有上进野心。公司为表彰其卓越贡献，特意将他的意识数字化，让其继续为公司服务与勉励其他后世的员工。
value: A mechanized unit driven berserk by Devour contamination, capable of annihilating enemies with overwhelming firepower. Valente was sharp, efficient, and relentlessly ambitious, maintaining absolute focus on his work while constantly striving for bigger things. In recognition of his exceptional contributions, the company digitized his consciousness so he could continue serving the corporation and inspire future generations of employees.

key: 不知名的世界被原态侵蚀毁灭后，曾经生活于其中的生物遗留在侵蚀中的倒影。它们没有思想和智慧，只剩世界毁灭时的意志化作的强大攻击性，驱使它们永无止境地相互残杀。
value: After an unknown world was destroyed by Primordial Devour, what remained were echoes of the beings that once lived there, left behind within the Devour itself. They possess no thought or intelligence, only a fierce, unending aggression formed from the will of that world's final collapse, driving them to slaughter one another without end.

key: 因侵蚀而产生逻辑链路紊乱的人形机器人。最初以保护人员为方针设计的机器人，如今它手上的利刃化为了那些当初被保护者最恐惧的阴影。
value: A humanoid robot whose logic circuits were disrupted by Devour. Originally designed with the protection of personnel in mind, the robot's blades have now become the very shadow feared by those it was meant to protect.

key: 因侵蚀而产生逻辑链路紊乱的镇爆型机器人。这种携带矢量步枪的机器人精确致命、虚无单发。人们都很喜欢这样充满效率的好家伙，直到这份效率被应用在他们身上。
value: A riot-control robot whose logic circuits were disrupted by Devour. Armed with a vector rifle, it delivers precise and lethal shots with ruthless efficiency. People always loved machines this efficient, right up until that efficiency was turned against them.

value: A security robot whose logic circuits malfunctioned under the effects of Devour. Designed specifically to protect high-value personnel, this premium model was equipped with advanced martial arts and close-combat techniques, making it the top choice among corporate clients. The company's customer support lines are probably overwhelmed by now.

key:
由视讯器与蜘蛛组合而成的异合型蚀生体。较为罕见的蚀生体类型，通常出没于被侵蚀吞没的人类居住区中。传闻显像蛛骸会放映出受害者最为恐惧的视讯画面，让这些受害者一步步落入危险的圈套之中并猎杀他们……

value:
A hybrid Devourborne formed from a video display unit and a spider. A relatively rare type of Devourborne commonly found in human settlements consumed by Devour. [Note: The rumor is false, but its playback content can be influenced via close-range signal transmission. However, the result is usually a snow-like pattern of scrambled interference.]

key: 以收讯器与大型兽类组合而成的异合型蚀生体。它的巨大身躯以常人理解的灵敏对敌人发动势大力沉的攻击。一般来说，就算有侵蚀能的加持，生物体与机械体也很难进行如此恰当的耦合，而我只能从那些深入骨髓的机械芯片与肢体边缘的缝合线上，窥视过往真相的一鳞半爪……
value: A hybrid Devourborne created from a receiver fused with a massive beast. Despite its enormous body, it attacks with shocking speed and crushing force far beyond normal understanding. Even enhanced by Devour Energy, biological and mechanical lifeforms should not be able to integrate this perfectly. Yet from the mechanical chips embedded deep in the bone and the sutured seams along the edges of the body, one can glimpse fragments of a terrible truth from the past...

key: 在原态侵蚀的黄昏中独自游荡的孤独骑士。虽然只是不知何年代流落到侵蚀中的一道遗影，但从无数彷徨遗影中拼杀而出的他，拥有令人仰望的实力和战斗意志，甚至时刻保持着最适合战斗的姿态。即使是那些强大的使徒也不愿轻撄其锋。如此超群之人，在其生活的年代绝不会是籍籍无名之辈。
value: A lone knight wandering through the twilight of Primordial Devour. Though merely a lingering shadow cast into the Devour from some forgotten era, he carved his way through countless lost echoes and emerged with overwhelming strength and unshakable battle instinct. Even now, he maintains a stance perfectly suited for combat at all times. Even the mighty apostles avoid crossing blades with him lightly. A warrior of such caliber could never have been a nobody in his own age.

key: 黑厅为巡卫组配备的标准供能单元。设计理念侧重稳定与持久，能够满足长时间巡逻的能源需求，其输出功率专为常规勤务优化，不适合高烈度连续作战。
value: A standard power supply unit issued to Black Hall Patrol Units. Designed with stability and endurance in mind, it can support long-term patrol operations. Its output is optimized for routine duties and is not suited for sustained high-intensity combat.

key: 黑厅为巡卫组配备的基础防护面罩。优化了长时间佩戴的舒适性与基础密闭性，可有效过滤环境粉尘及标准浓度黑质粒子，面对高强度侵蚀环境需额外防护。
value: A basic protective mask issued to Black Hall Patrol Units. Optimized for long-term comfort and basic airtightness, it effectively filters environmental dust and standard concentrations of Tenebrium particles. Additional protection is required in high-intensity Devour environments.

key: 黑厅为巡卫组配备的导航与记录仪。集成路径记录、区域标记及短距通讯功能，在已测绘稳定区域内定位可靠，于强干扰或未标记环境中的精度会下降。
value: A navigation and recording device issued to Black Hall Patrol Units. Integrates route tracking, area marking, and short-range communication functions. Provides reliable positioning within mapped and stable regions, though accuracy decreases in heavily disrupted or unmapped environments.

key: 黑厅为巡卫组配备的标准辅助增强模块。激活后可平稳提升使用者的基础力量与神经反应速度，旨在应对常规冲突，设计侧重于持续性与稳定性。
value: A standard support enhancement module issued to Black Hall Patrol Units. Once activated, it steadily enhances the user's physical strength and neural response speed. Designed primarily for handling routine conflicts, with an emphasis on reliability and sustained performance.

key: 黑市流通的改装供能单元。由多个来源不明的二手部件拼合而成，输出功率存在波动，可满足基础作战的短时能源需求，但连续高负荷运行时存在过载风险。
value: A modified power supply unit circulated on the black market. Assembled from secondhand parts of questionable origin, its output fluctuates unpredictably. It can satisfy short-term energy demands for basic combat, though continuous high-load operation carries a significant risk of overload.

key: 黑市流通的翻新防护面罩。基础结构经过多次修补与强化，滤芯采用非标混合材料，对常规侵蚀环境提供基础防护，密闭性与长期可靠性低于正规制式装备。
value: A refurbished protective mask circulated on the black market. Its basic structure has undergone repeated repairs and reinforcement, while the filter core uses non-standard composite materials. It offers basic protection against ordinary Devour environments, though its sealing capability and long-term reliability fall short of official-grade equipment.

key: 黑市流通的改装定位仪。核心传感器件来自淘汰的军用或民用设备，信号接收与解算能力不完整，在已知稳定区域能提供基础导向功能，定位精度与抗干扰能力较弱。
value: A modified locator device circulated on the black market. Its core sensor components were salvaged from decommissioned military or civilian equipment. Signal reception and processing capabilities are incomplete, allowing only basic navigation in stable, known regions. Positioning accuracy and anti-interference performance are relatively poor.

key: 黑市流通的激素调控模块。通过注射混合激素与神经刺激剂，可在短时间内提升使用者的机体反应与力量水平，效果结束后会出现不同程度的疲劳与感官钝化现象。
value: A hormone regulation module circulated on the black market. By injecting a blend of hormones and neural stimulants, it temporarily enhances the user's reflexes and physical strength. Once the effects wear off, varying degrees of fatigue and sensory dullness will occur.

key: 由重型载具动力核心改造的供能装置。移除限制器后能以部件加速损耗为代价，短时输出超高功率，为临时搭载的高耗能设备供能。
value: A power supply device converted from the core of a heavy transport vehicle. With its limiters removed, it can deliver extremely high short-term output at the cost of accelerated component degradation, supplying temporary power to high-consumption equipment.

key: 由多种战术镜片拼合而成的复合目镜。集成微光、热感与震动感知模块，可在无光或强干扰环境中有效捕捉并勾勒生物目标的轮廓与轨迹。
value: Composite goggles assembled from multiple tactical lenses. Integrates low-light, thermal, and vibration detection modules, allowing them to effectively detect and outline the contours and movement paths of biological targets in darkness or heavily disrupted environments.

key: 可主动激活的伪装式诱骗装置。启动后能够模拟特定生命体征或高能量源的信号特征，用以吸引、误导或干扰周边蚀生体的感知系统，从而创造战术时机或转移威胁。
value: An actively deployable camouflage decoy device. Once activated, it can simulate the signal patterns of specific lifeforms or high-energy sources, attracting, misleading, or disrupting the perception systems of nearby Devourborne to create tactical openings or divert threats.

key: 集成数据存储与实时分析功能的便携设备。可记录并比对战场数据，依据历史信息对已知类型目标的行动模式与结构弱点进行快速标记与推算。
value: A portable device integrating data storage and real-time analysis functions. It can record and compare battlefield data, rapidly identifying and calculating behavioral patterns and structural weaknesses of known target types based on historical records.

key: 海文利初代仿生学产品。其运作机制模拟了发光水母的能量转换过程，可在中低浓度侵蚀环境中稳定过滤并转化环境能量，为系统提供平稳、洁净的基础供能。
value: Havenly's first-generation bionics product. Its operating mechanism imitates the energy conversion process of bioluminescent jellyfish, enabling it to steadily filter and convert environmental energy within low- to medium-level Devour environments, providing stable and clean baseline power to the system.

key: 海文利初代仿生学产品。面罩内层嵌有仿生智能色素细胞，可依据外部能量流强度与光谱变化瞬时调节透光率与滤光波段，在强视觉干扰中有效保护使用者并提取关键信息。
value: Havenly's first-generation bionics product. The inner layer of the mask is embedded with biomimetic intelligent pigment cells capable of instantly adjusting light transmission and filtering wavelengths according to fluctuations in external energy flow and spectral changes, effectively protecting the user from visual interference while extracting critical information.

key: 海文利初代仿生学产品。灵感源于鲸豚与蝙蝠的生物回声定位系统，可通过发射并接收特定频谱的主动声波，穿透视觉盲区，构建基于声学反射的三维环境结构模型。
value: Havenly's first-generation bionics product. Inspired by the biological echolocation systems of whales, dolphins, and bats, it emits and receives active sound waves within specific frequency ranges, penetrating visual blind spots to construct three-dimensional environmental models based on acoustic reflections.

key: 海文利初代仿生学产品。形态与动作模拟蝠鲼在水中的滑翔，能利用压力差实现超乎寻常的静默移动与急速变向，帮助使用者在复杂地形中保持优越的位控能力。
value: Havenly's first-generation bionics product. Its movement and structure imitate the gliding motion of manta rays underwater, using pressure differentials to achieve exceptional silent movement and rapid directional shifts, helping the user maintain superior positional control in complex terrain.

key: 海文利为集团内部安防组配备的标准供能单元。采用高集成模块化设计，在保障长时间稳定运行的同时具备快速响应能力，其输出特性专为常规安防任务优化。
value: A standard power supply unit issued to Havenly Group's internal security teams. Featuring a highly integrated modular design, it ensures stable long-term operation while retaining rapid response capabilities. Its output profile is optimized specifically for standard security operations.

key: 海文利为安防组配备的战术防护面罩。除标准密闭与过滤功能外，集成了热信号分析模块，可依据目标热特征实时评估威胁等级，并对高危险目标进行视觉标记与预警提示。
value: A tactical protective mask issued by Havenly to security teams. In addition to standard sealing and filtration functions, it integrates a thermal signature analysis module capable of assessing threat levels in real time based on target heat signatures, while visually marking and warning against high-risk targets.

key: 海文利为集团内部安防组配备的态势感知与调度单元。集成区域环境监控、加密通讯与战术标记功能，能够对安防区域内的动态事件进行记录与信息统合，并为团队提供基础战术指引。
value: A situational awareness and coordination unit issued to Havenly Group's internal security teams. Integrates environmental monitoring, encrypted communications, and tactical marking functions, allowing it to record and consolidate dynamic events within secured areas while providing teams with baseline tactical guidance.

key: 海文利为安防组配备的战术协调增强器。激活后提升使用者反应与执行能力，支持与指挥系统实时同步，接收战术指令，强化团队协同效率。
value: A tactical coordination enhancer issued by Havenly to security teams. Once activated, it enhances the user's reflexes and operational efficiency, supporting real-time synchronization with command systems to receive tactical directives and improve overall team coordination.

key:
用于存储特殊御能者中枢信息的频带。
由侵蚀管理局制作并发放，具备高保真存储的性能。
value:
A band used to store specialized Surgactor data.
Produced and distributed by the E.Z.C, with high-fidelity storage capabilities.

key:
蚀瀑精英枪手的武器。可用于技能升级。
枪上斑驳的使用痕迹透露出使用者的粗心与随意。

被电波鞘甲骸侵蚀并吸收后成为了它身体上的一部分，可惜它的屏幕上再也不会显示任何内容。
value:
An corrupted monitor dropped by "Sheathusk." Can be used for Skill Upgrades and Gear Crafting.
Consumed and assimilated by the Electrowave Sheathbeetle Husk, it became part of the creature's body. Unfortunately, its screen will never display anything again.

key:
自“鞘骸”身上掉落的能量结晶，可用于技能升级与装备打造。
被电波鞘甲骸侵蚀并吸收后成为了它身体上的一部分，只是在这不见天日的工厂中，原本最重要的发电功能却不再起效。
value:
Dropped from "Sheathusk," this energy crystal can be used for Skill Upgrades and Gear Crafting.
Consumed and assimilated by the Electrowave Sheathbeetle Husk, it became part of the creature's body. Yet here, in this sunless factory, its once-critical power generation function no longer serves any purpose.

key:
由克瑞斯集团所发行的货币，用途甚为广泛。
大侵蚀事件发生后，世界范围内的金融体系遭遇重创。为全面重建经济秩序，该货币的发行在联合会议上予以核准通过。
value:
A currency issued by the Creyce Group, widely used across many sectors.
After the Great Devour, the global financial system suffered a catastrophic collapse. To fully rebuild the economic order, the issuance of this currency was formally approved during the United Assembly.

key:
能够提升愈合药剂剂效的稳定液，只可用于部分特定的愈合注射器。
可在注入疗愈注射器后，于注射管内壁形成涂层，与愈合药剂接触后可提高药剂的剂效。
value:
A stabilizing agent that enhances the effectiveness of healing compounds. Compatible only with certain specialized healing injectors.
When injected into a recovery injector, it forms a coating along the inner wall of the injector chamber that amplifies the healing compound's effectiveness upon contact.

key: 破败的大厅中，康拉德的雕像静静矗立，不再受任何人的瞻仰。
value: In the ruined hall, Konrad's statue still stood in silence, no longer admired by anyone.

value: An outfit personally selected by the EAS Officer for ROCHE. Bright and energetic in color. On holidays, ROCHE loves wearing it to roam the streets, chasing the wind and exploring freely.

key:
自我积累和成长的佐证，用于提升御能者等级。
既往的经历和见闻，塑造了现在的自我。
value:
Proof of personal growth and experience, used to increase Attuner Level.
Past experiences and discoveries are what shaped who you are today.

key: 有时候，绕远路才是真正的近路。
穿过漫长的通道，机械的大门为你敞开，似乎有什么在指引着你前进……
沉睡的机械战士被唤醒，穿过火线与屏障，破损的机器为你提供前进的线索……
value: A dormant mechanical warrior awakens. Through gunfire and barriers, broken machines leave behind clues to guide your way forward...

key:
荒废许久的工厂深处，火红的淬炼阻挡前进的脚步。
藏于尽头的蒙尘实验室，蕴藏着怎样的秘密？
人们总是追逐着高处的星辰，借助一切力量，去寻得触碰光辉的机会。

即便早已空无一物，腐朽的屏障依旧忠实履行着职责。
曾经输送无数机械战士的载具，正带领你前往最终的地点……
value:
Even now, long devoid of anything, the decaying barrier still dutifully performs its function.
The transport that once carried countless mechanical soldiers now guides you toward the final destination...

key:
你竟再次看到地上的风景。
本该荒废的兵工厂为何依旧运作着？答案便在前方。
value:
You once again see the scenery on the ground.
Why does the supposedly abandoned armory still remain operational? The answer lies ahead.

key: 骑士已然沉睡，但留存的战车仍然能够指引前进的方向。
这里好像在守着某样东西，不肯让人触碰，也不肯让人带走。
冷却的炉心重新亮起，废弃的生产线正等待新的燃料。
是怪物的嘶吼，还是昔日荣光在低诉。
我们究竟是抵抗者，还是闯入者？
他们会不会也是曾在这里迷途的人。
混乱的根源，或许就在这里。唯有将此处清除，才能换来安宁。
警报声在空旷厂区回荡，机械残骸从阴影中再次站起。
输送带尽头堆满未完成的兵器，谁还在为它们下达指令？
熔炉的余温尚未散尽，沉默的工厂仍在履行最后一道命令。
这里还有无数紧闭的闸门，背后又藏着怎么样的故事？
楼顶的空旷斜道，可以运送大型器械，同时也告诉来到这里的人：你即将离开塔楼。
value: The wide, sloping path atop the building is used to transport heavy equipment, but it also serves as a reminder to all who pass through: you're about to leave the tower behind.

key: 鲜有人知的隐蔽过道，曾经被用作应急通道使用。
value: A hidden passage known to few, once used as an emergency escape route.

key: 前行之路布满荆棘，向上攀登或有生机。
时空裂隙指引我们来到这里，残片内部究竟是机遇还是险境？

由韦伯通讯建设的监测塔，能够发送和接收特殊的长波频段，能够最大程度避免因侵蚀区而产生的信号丢失，满足御能者在侵蚀区内的通讯需求。
虽然基站在设计上配备了多种侵蚀防护手段，但面对侵蚀区瞬息万变的恶劣环境，还是会频繁离线。离线的基站往往经过简单维护就能恢复正常运转。
value:
A signal relay base constructed by Weber Communications, capable of transmitting and receiving specialized longwave frequencies, minimizing signal loss caused by Devouring Areas and ensuring communication support for Attuners within affected areas.
Although equipped with multiple Devour-resistant systems, the rapidly changing hostile environment often forces it offline. With simple maintenance, it can usually be restored.

value: Unusual activity has been detected at the fallen ruins known as Newt Base. You've been ordered to investigate, uncovering the truth behind the bastion.

key:
"那只狡猾的蚀生体潜藏在暗处，对你和你的小队发动了偷袭。
你很清楚，即使放弃任务，这只蚀生体恐怕也不会轻易放你们离开。
现在的选项只剩一个，那就是放手一搏。"
value:
"The cunning Devourborne lurking in the shadows ambushed you and your squad.
You know all too well that even abandoning the mission wouldn't guarantee your escape—this thing has no intention of letting you walk away that easily.
There's only one option left now: go all in."

key:
因与泽尔联合跟契尔斯通存在旧怨，海文利集团的薇诺娜决定帮助我们，她给了我们一张不限额的黑卡，同时让终于自己的下属带我们前往契尔斯通的走私窗口，令我们能够伪装成客户，与走私负责人完成接头。
现在我需要找到那名薇诺娜的下属，获知下一步行动的安排。
value:
Because of old conflicts between the Zelle Complex and Keystone, Vinona of the Havenly Group decided to help us. She provided us with an unlimited black card and arranged for one of her subordinates to take us to Keystone's smuggling entry point, allowing us to pose as clients and make contact with the smuggling handler.
I now need to find that subordinate and confirm the next step of the operation.

key:
在向中转站的守卫表明来意后，我们顺利进入了忘却峡中转站，并且与走私负责人古恩（也是中转站的副站长）完成了洽谈。
从洽谈中我与何雨莲套取到关键信息——契尔斯通竟然堂而皇之地将走私数据储存在中转站的机房内……
另一边，为引走守卫而假装肚子疼的何雨莲似乎也有所发现……
value:
After explaining our purpose to the station guards, we successfully entered the Forgotten Gorge Transfer Hub and met with the smuggling handler, Gunn (also the hub's Deputy Station Chief), to negotiate.
During the discussion, I managed to extract key information with LIAN—Keystone is openly storing smuggling data inside the station's server room...
Meanwhile, LIAN, who pretended to have a stomachache to lure away the guards, seems to have discovered something on her end as well...

key:
何雨莲发来短信，告诉我艾斯塔娜已经对黑厅采取了种种手段，但她仍然没有放弃帮助我追回“时空奇点”，再次与我相约见面商议。
就在我准备动身与何雨莲会面时，却发现泽尔联合对我也采取了措施……
value:
LIAN sent me a message saying Enstana had already taken various measures against the Black Hall, but she still hadn't given up on helping me recover the "Spatiotemporal Singularity," and wanted to meet again to discuss next steps.
Just as I was preparing to head out, I realized Zelle Complex had also started making moves against me...

key:

但营地内的几处闸门似乎被人刻意关闭，我必须尽快找到解锁闸门的办法，同时留意营地里是否还有其他可疑的地方。
value:
The Nightstalker was indeed hiding here. I had a feeling the "Spatiotemporal Singularity" was here as well...
However, several gates in the camp appeared to have been deliberately sealed. I needed to find a way to unlock them as soon as possible while keeping an eye out for anything else suspicious in the area.

你们决定找到二号电梯井，并通过它抵达基地的最深处。
value:
After investigating the broadcast tower, you learn that the anomaly at Newt Base is caused by a massive gate deep within the facility that is about to open, releasing a mysterious entity sealed inside.
You decide to find Elevator Shaft No. 2 and use it to reach the deepest part of the base.

key:
克洛托典藏系列时装。
她身披夜色而来，眸中盈着满月清辉，聚光灯的明灭如昼夜交替般漫长，绮丽的梦境在瞬间定格成永恒。
盈盈一笑间，指尖流光轻转，她向你伸出手，嗓音如珍珠滑过丝缎——“尊贵的客人，愿意与我共舞一曲吗？”
value:
Clotho archive collection outfit.
She arrives draped in the night itself, moonlight shimmering in her eyes. The rise and fall of the spotlight stretches on like an endless cycle of day and night, until a dazzling dream is frozen into eternity in a single fleeting moment.
With a gentle smile, light dances across her fingertips as she extends a hand toward you, her voice smooth as pearls gliding across silk. "Distinguished guest... would you care to share a dance with me?"
